verses.text: Hadien ka jingïap jong u Moses u shakri u Trai, u Trai U la kren ha u Joshwa, u khun u Nun, u nongbud nongrap jong u Moses,
“U Moses, u shakri jong Nga u la ïap, namarkata to ïeng, to leit sha shiliang kane ka Jordan, ma phi bad kine ki paid baroh, sha ka ri kaba Ngan ai ha ki paid u Israel.
Nga la ai ha phi ïa ka jaka baroh ba ka pohjat jong phi kan ïuh, kumba Nga la kular ha u Moses.
Naduh ri kynjah bad une u lum Lebanon haduh ka wah bah Ïuphratis, ka ri baroh jong ki Hit haduh ka Duriaw Bakhraw shaphang sepngi kan long ka ri jong phi.
Yn ym don briew u ban lah pynwit ïa phi baroh shi lynter ka jingim jong phi. Kumba Nga la don bad u Moses, Ngan don kumjuh ruh bad phi. Ngan ym lyndet ne ieh noh ïa phi.
To long keiñ u bakhlaiñ bad u bashlur, namar phi phin pynïoh ha kine ki paid ïa ka ri ba Nga la kular ha ki kpa jong ki ban ai ha ki.

Tang ba phi dei ban long u bakhlaiñ bad u bashlur shibun, uba sumar ban leh katkum ka aiñ baroh kaba u Moses, u shakri jong Nga, u la hukum ïa phi. Wat phai sha kamon ne sha kadiang khnang ba phin dup manbha kat shaba phi leit.

Wat thait ban kren shaphang kane ka kitab jong ka aiñ, hynrei to puson ïa ka bad sngi bad miet, khnang ba phin dup phikir ban leh kat ïa kaba la thoh ha ka. Hangta phin sa manbha ha ki jingleh jong phi, hangta phin sa jop.
Hato ngam shym la hukum ïa phi? To long u bakhlaiñ bad u bashlur! Wat sheptieng, ne wat khaw-eit. U Trai u Blei jong phi Un don lem bad phi kat shaba phi leit.”
Te u Joshwa u la hukum ïa ki rangbah jong ki paid,

“Khie leit sha ki ïing dara baroh sawdong bad ïathuh kumne ïa ki paidbah, ‘To taïar lypa ïa la ki jynbam jyndih. Hapoh lai sngi phi dei ban leit sha shiliang kane ka Jordan, ban leit buhai shnong ïa ka ri kaba u Trai u Blei jong phi U la ai ïa phi ban ïoh kynti.’”
Ha ki jait Reuben, ki jait Gad bad ka shiteng ka jait Manasse, u Joshwa u la ong,
“To kynmaw ïa ka ktien kaba u Moses, u shakri u Trai u la hukum ïa phi, ‘U Trai u Blei jong phi Un ai ïa phi ka jaka shongthait, da kaba ai ïa kane ka ri ha phi .’

Ki tnga jong phi, ki khun rit jong phi bad ki jynri jong phi kin sah ha ka ri kaba u Moses u la ai ïa phi sha shiliang ka Jordan, hynrei phi ki ’riewïaleh baroh phin ïaid bad la ki tiar ïapom hakhmat ki para jong phi ban dup ïarap ïa ki,

haduh ba u Trai Un ai jingshongthait ïa ki para jong phi bad ïa phi ruh, bad ba ki la buhai shnong ïa ka ri ba u Trai u Blei jong phi U la ai ïa ki. Te hangta phin sa wan phai sha ka ri ba phin ïoh kynti, ban buhai shnong ïa ka, ka ri ba u Moses, u shakri u Trai, u la ai ïa phi sha lyndet ka Jordan shaphang mihngi.”
Te ki la jubab ïa u Joshwa, “Baroh kat kaba phi la hukum ïa ngi, ngin leh, bad kat shaba phi phah ïa ngi, ngin leit.
Kumba ngi la kohnguh ïa u Moses ha kiei kiei baroh, kumta ruh ngin kohnguh thik ïa phi; tang ba u Trai u Blei jong phi Un don lem bad phi, kumba U la don lem bad u Moses!
Kat uba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka hukum jong phi bad ubym kohnguh ïa ki ktien kiba phi la hukum ïa u, un sa shah pynïap. Tang ba to long u bakhlaiñ bad u bashlur keiñ.”

Te u Joshwa, u khun u Nun, u la phah jar jar ar ngut ki rangbah na Shittim kum ki nongsyntiat, u da ong, “Khie leit peit ïa ka ri, khamtam ïa ka Jerikho;” Te ki la leit bad ki la poi ha ïing jong kawei ka nuti kaba kyrteng ka Rahab, bad ki la sah miet hangta.
Hynrei la don ba pyntip ïa u syiem Jerikho, “To sumar naba katto katne ngut ki rangbah Israel ki la wan poi hangne mynta ka miet ban peit syntiat ïa ka ri.”
Hangta u syiem Jerikho u la phah ktien sha ka Rahab u da ong, “Sei shabar ïa ki briew kiba wan rung ha ïing jong pha namar ki la wan ban peit syntiat ïa ka ri jong ngi.”
Hynrei kata ka kynthei ka la phah rieh ïa kita ki rangbah ar ngut bad ka la ong, “Hooid, don ki rangbah kiba la wan sha nga, hynrei ngam tip satia nangno ki la wan.
Bad ynda la dum, haba lajan khang ïa ka khyrdop, kita ki briew ki la leit shabar. Ki la leit shano ngam tip. Beh kloi kloi nadien jong ki, bad phin sa lap ïa ki.”
Hynrei ka la leit ïalam ïa ki sha tnum ïing bad ka la pynrieh ïa ki hapoh ki jyntang dieng ’saihon kiba ka la thad riang halor tnum ïing.
Kumta kita ki rangbah ki la beh nadien jong ki na ka lynti kaba leit sha Jordan haduh ki jaka ba ju kam ïa ka wah. Mar ïaleit kita ki nongbeh, la khang ruh ïa ka khyrdop.
Shuwa ba kin thiah, ka la leit sha ki halor tnum ïing.
Te ka la ong ha kita ki rangbah, “Nga tip ba u Trai U la ai ha phi ïa kane ka ri, bad ngi la kem tieng ïa phi. Baroh ki shnong ki thaw jong ka ri ki la tlor mynsiem tang shu wan ma phi.

Namar ngi la ïohsngew kumno u Trai U la pynrngat ïa ki um jong ka Duriaw Basaw hakhmat jong phi mynba phi la mih na Ijipt, bad aïu pat phi la leh ïa ki syiem Amor ar ngut kiba sha shiliang ka Jordan, nangta sa ïa u Sihon bad u Ok, haduh ba ki da lko pom.

Ngi tang shu ïohsngew ïa kata, ngi la shu tlor dohnud bad ki rangbah baroh ki la her mynsiem na ka daw jong phi, namar u Trai u Blei jong phi U dei u Blei Uba don ha bneng shajrong bad ha khyndew shapoh.
Te mynta, to kular ïa nga da u Trai. Kumba nga la leh sbun ïa phi, phi ruh phin leh sbun kylliang ïa ka ïing u kpa jong nga, bad to ai ïa nga ka dak ka bathikna,
ba phin pyllait im ïa u kpa bad ka kmie jong nga, ïa ki hynmen ki para jong nga, shynrang bad kynthei, bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba dei ki jong ki, bad phin pyllait ïa ngi na ka jingïap.”

Kumta kita ki rangbah ki la ong, “Ka jingim jong ngi na ka bynta ka jong phi! Lada phim ïathuh briew ïa kane ka kam jong ngi, khlem artatien ngin sa leh sbun ïa phi ynda u Trai U ai ïa kane ka ri ha ngi.”
Nangta ka la pynhiar ïa ki na jynkhang-ïit da u tyllai, namar ka ïing jong ka ka dei hamar syndah kynroh shnong, bad ka shong ïing hangta.
Ka la ong, “Khie sha ki lum, ïoh ki nongbeh ki lap ïa phi. Rieh hangta lai sngi haduh ba kin da wan phai, nangta phi lah ban leit la ka lynti.”
Kita ki rangbah pat ki la jubab, “Ha kane ka rukom ngin sa pyndep ïa ka jingsmai kaba phi la pynsmai ïa ngi.

Ynda ngi wan rung hapoh ka ri, phin teh ïa une u ’saisaw ha ka jynkhang-ïit ba phi la pynhiar ïa ngi, bad phin lum lang ha ïing jong phi ïa u kpa bad ka kmie jong phi, ïa ki hynmen para shynrang jong phi, bad ïa kiba ha ïing ha sem baroh jong u kpa jong phi.

Lada uno uno u mih shabar na ïing jong phi ha surok, ka snam jong u kan long halor ka khlieh jong u hi, bad ngin ym kit pap ei ei. Lada don ba ktah kti ïa uno uno uba don bad phi hapoh ïing, ka snam jong u kan long halor ka khlieh jong ngi.
Nangta pat de lada phi ïathuh briew ïa kane ka kam jong ngi, ngi ngin lait na ka jingsmai kaba phi la pynsmai ïa ngi.”
Ka pat ka la jubab, “To ai kan long kumba la ong.” Nangta ka la phah noh ïa ki bad ki la leit. Ka la teh ïa u ’saisaw ha jynkhang-ïit.
Kumta ki la mih bad ki la leit sha ki lum. Ki la sah hangta lai sngi haduh ba yn da wan phai ki nongbeh kiba la wad ïa ki artat artat lynti khlem da lap hangno hangno.
Hadien kata, kita ki rangbah ar ngut ki la wan hiar na ki lum, ki la jam sha shiliang bad ki la wan sha u Joshwa, u khun u Nun. Ki la ïathuh lut ha u kat kaba la jia ïa ki.
Ki la ong ha u Joshwa, “Da shisha shisha u Trai U la ai ïa ka ri ha ki kti jong ngi, bad nalor nangta ki trai shnong baroh kim don mynsiem shuh ba ki tieng eh ïa ngi.”
Dang step phyrngab, u Joshwa bad ki paid Israel baroh ki la khie bad ki la mih na Shittim. Ynda ki la poi ha Jordan, ki la sangeh hangta shuwa ban jam sha shiliang.
Hadien lai sngi ki rangbah ki la ïaid tawiar ïa ki ïing dara.
Ki la ai hukum kumne ïa ki paidbah, “Phi tang shu ïohi ïa ka synduk jong ka jutang u Trai u Blei jong phi ba ki lyngdoh Lebi ki bah, phin ïamih baroh na la ki jaka jaka bad bud ïa ka,
khnang ba phin dup tip ïa ka lynti ba phin leit namarba phim pat ju ïaid ïa kane ka lynti mynshuwa. Hynrei phi dei ban kham pajih na ka, jngai antad kumba ar hajar pruh; wat leit hajan jong ka.”
U Joshwa u la ong ha ki paidbah, “To pynkhuid ïa lade, namar lashai u Trai Un sa leh ki kam phylla hapdeng jong phi.”
Nangta u Joshwa u la ong sa ha ki lyngdoh, “To shim ïabah ïa ka synduk jong ka jutang, bad to ïaid nakhmat u paidbah.” Bad ki la bah ïa ka synduk jong ka jutang bad ki la leit nakhmat ki paidbah.
Te u Trai U la kren ha u Joshwa, “Ha kane ka sngi Ngan sdang ban pyndon burom ïa phi hakhmat ki Israel baroh, khnang ba kin dup tip ba Ngan don lem bad phi kumba Nga la don bad u Moses.
Bad phin hukum ïa ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka synduk jong ka jutang, ‘Ynda phi poi ha thmit jong ki um ka Jordan phin ïeng thik ha ka Jordan.’ ”
Kumta u Joshwa u la ong ha ki paid Israel, “Wan shane, bad to sngap ïa ki ktien u Trai u Blei jong phi.”

Hangta u Joshwa u la kren, “Da kane to tip ba u Blei ba-im U don hapdeng jong phi bad ba Un sa beh krad khlem artatien nakhmat jong phi ïa ki Kanaan, ki Hit, ki Hib, ki Peris, ki Girkash, ki Amor bad ki Jebus.
Hakhmih, ka synduk jong ka jutang u Trai ka khyndew baroh kan sa ïaid lyngba ka Jordan hakhmat jong phi.
Namarkata jied khat-ar ngut ki rangbah na ki jait ka Israel, na kawei kawei ka jait uwei u rangbah.

Haba ki pohjat jong ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka synduk jong u Trai—u Trai jong ka pyrthei baroh—ki ïeng ha ki um ka Jordan, ki um ka Jordan kin sangeh ban tuid bad ki um kiba na shaneng kin ïeng kum kawei ka kynton.”
Te ka la jia ba haba ki paidbah ki la mih na ki ïing dara jong ki, ban kam sha shiliang ka Jordan ryngkat bad ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka synduk jong ka jutang hakhmat hakhmat,
bad haba kito kiba bah ïa ka synduk ka jutang ki la poi ha Jordan bad ki kjat jong ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka synduk ki la ïuh ïa ka um kaba harud wah (ka Jordan ka ju shlei miar baroh shi aïom ot),

ki um kiba wan na shaneng ki la ïeng kum ka kynton na shajngai, ha Adam, ka nongbah kaba hajan Zarethan, bad kito pat kiba tuid sharum shaphang ka duriaw jong ka Araba, ka Duriaw Mluh, kim tuid shuh; kumta ki paidbah ki la kam sha shiliang mar pyrshah Jerikho.

Te katba ki Israel ki dang ïaïaid halor ka jaka barkhiang, ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka synduk jong ka jutang u Trai ki la ïeng ha ka jaka rkhiang hapdeng ka Jordan, haduh ba u paid bynriew baroh phar u la dep ban kam sha shiliang ka Jordan.
Haba u paid bynriew baroh u la dep ban kam sha shiliang ka Jordan, u Trai U la kren ha u Joshwa,
“To jied khat-ar ngut ki rangbah, uwei u rangbah man ka shi jait,

bad hukum ïa ki kumne, ‘To shim rah khat-ar tylli ki maw nangne napdeng ka Jordan, na ka jaka kaba ki kjat jong ki lyngdoh ki la ïeng. Rah ïa ki bad phi bad sa buh ha ka jaka ba phin sah miet mynta.’ ”
Te u Joshwa u la khot ïa ki rangbah khat-ar ngut kiba u la thung napdeng u paid Israel, uwei u rangbah na kawei kawei ka jait.

Bad u Joshwa u la ong ha ki, “To khie ïaid shakhmat ka synduk jong u Trai u Blei jong phi haduh pdeng ka Jordan, bad to ïabah mar uwei uwei u maw halor tyrpeng katkum ka jingbun ki jait u paid Israel.
To ai ba kane kan long ka dak hapdeng jong phi ba ynda ki khun jong phi kin kylli hadien habud, ‘Kine ki maw ki mut aïu sha?’

Hangta phi sa ïathuh ïa ki ba ïa ki um ka Jordan la pynïakhlad hakhmat ka synduk jong ka jutang u Trai; haba ka la ïaid sha shiliang ka Jordan, ïa ki um ka Jordan la phiah ar liang. Kumta kine ki maw kin long ka jingkynmaw nam shi junom ïa ki paid Israel.”

Te ki rangbah Israel ki la leh thik kumba u Joshwa u la hukum ïa ki. Ki la rah khat-ar tylli ki maw napdeng ka Jordan, katta tylli katba don ki jait jong u paid Israel. Ki la rah ïa ki shaduh ka jaka ba ki la sah miet bad ki la buh ïa ki hangta.
U Joshwa nangta u la pynïeng khat-ar tylli ki maw hapdeng ka Jordan hamar ka jaka ba ki kjat jong ki lyngdoh kiba la bah ïa ka synduk jong ka jutang ki la ïeng. Haduh kane ka sngi ki dang don hangta.

Ki lyngdoh kiba la bah ïa ka synduk ki la ïeng hapdeng ka Jordan haduh ban da dep baroh kat kaba u Trai U la hukum ïa u Joshwa ban ïathuh ha u paidbah, kat kumba u Moses u la bthah ïa u Joshwa. Ki paidbah ki la ïaid kyrkieh.
Ynda u paidbah baroh u la dep ïaid sha shiliang, ka synduk jong u Trai bad ki lyngdoh ki la ïaid sha shiliang hakhmat u paidbah.
Ki khun shynrang jong u Reuben bad jong u Gad, bad jong ka shiteng ka jait u Manasse ki la leit sha shiliang bad la ki atiar ba la kieng hakhmat jong u paid Israel, kumba u Moses u la hukum ïa ki.
Kumba sawphew hajar ngut kiba la kieng atiar na ka bynta ka thma ki la ïaid sha shiliang hakhmat u Trai, sha ki pyntha ka Jerikho.
Ha kata ka sngi, u Trai U la pynkhraw ïa u Joshwa hakhmat ki paid Israel baroh. Te ki la tiengburom ïa u, kumba ki la tiengburom ïa u Moses, baroh shilynter ka jingim jong u.
Nangta u Trai U la ong ha u Joshwa,
“To hukum ïa ki lyngdoh kiba la bah ïa ka synduk jong ka Sakhi ban wan kiew na Jordan.”
U Joshwa namarkata u la hukum ïa ki lyngdoh, “To wan kiew na Jordan.”

Bad haba ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka synduk jong ka jutang u Trai ki la wan kiew napdeng ka Jordan, bad ki pohjat jong ki kjat jong ki ki la ïuh halor ka khyndew barkhiang, ki um jong ka Jordan ki la wan phai sha la ka jaka jong ki, bad ki la pynshlei ïa ki rud jong ka baroh, kum mynshuwa.
U paidbah u la wan kiew na Jordan ha ka sngi ka bashiphew jong u bnai banyngkong, bad ki la sher dara ha Gilgal, sha mihngi ka Jerikho.
Te u Joshwa u la kynton ha Gilgal ïa kito ki maw khat-ar tylli ba ki la wan rah na Jordan.
Bad u la ong ha u paid Israel, “Haba ki khun jong phi kin kylli ïa ki kpa jong phi lashai lashisngi, ‘Ki mut aïu sha kine ki maw?’
hangta phin sa pyntip ïa la ki khun, ki paid Israel ki la kam sha shiliang ka Jordan nalor ka khyndew ka barkhiang.’

Naba u Trai u Blei jong phi U la pynrngat ïa ki um ka Jordan na ka bynta jong phi haduh ba phin da ïaid sha shiliang, kumba u Trai u Blei jong phi U la leh ïa ka Duriaw Basaw, ïa kaba U la pynrngat na ka bynta jong ngi, haduh ba ngin da ïaid sha shiliang,
khnang ba ki jait bynriew baroh jong ka pyrthei kin dup tip ba ka kti u Trai ka long ka badonbor; ba phin dup tiengburom ïa u Trai u Blei jong phi junom.”

Haba ki Amor kiba sha sepngi ka Jordan bad ki syiem Kanaan baroh kiba harud duriaw ki la ïohsngew ba u Trai U la pynrngat ïa ki um ka Jordan na ka bynta u paidbah Israel haduh ba un da ïoh ïaid sha shiliang, ki la tlor ka dohnud bad ki la her mynsiem na ka bynta ki paid Israel.
Ha kata ka por u Trai U la ong ïa u Joshwa, “To shna ki tari mawshamok bad to otsher sa shi wat ïa u paid Israel.”
Kumta u Joshwa u la thaw ki tari mawshamok bad u la othser ïa u paid Israel ha Kibeath-ha-araloth.
Bad ka daw balei u Joshwa u la otsher biang ïa ki ka long kane: baroh ki shynrang bad ki ’riewthma jong u paid uba la mih na ri Ijipt ki la lah ïap ha lynti ha ri kynjah hadien ba ki la mih na Ijipt.
Shisha ki shynrang baroh kiba la mih ki la shah otsher, hynrei ki shynrang baroh kiba la kha ha ri kynjah hadien ba ki la mih na Ijipt kim pat ïoh jingotsher.

Naba u paid Israel u la ïaid sawphew snem ha ri kynjah, kumta u paid bynriew bad ki ’riewthma baroh kiba la mih na Ijipt ki la ïap namarba kim shym shah shkor ïa ka ktien jong u Trai. U Trai U la kular ha ki ba Un ym shah ïa ki ban ïohi ïa ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap, kaba U la kular ha ki kpa jong ki ban ai ha ngi.
Kumta dei ïa ki khun jong ki, ba U la pynmih bujli ha ka jaka jong ki, ba u Joshwa u la otsher. Ki la long kiba ym pat otsher, namarba ym shym la otsher ïa ki ha lynti.
Ynda la dep otsher ïa ki baroh, ki la sah ha la ki ïing dara haduh ba kin da koit.
Nangta u Trai U la ong ha u Joshwa, “Mynta ka sngi Nga la weng noh ïa ka jingkren beiñ kren khoh jong ka Ijipt na phi.” Kumta ïa kata ka jaka la ai kyrteng Gilgal haduh kane ka sngi.
Katba ki paid Israel ki dang ïasher dara ha Gilgal, ki la ïarakhe ïa ka Paskha ha ka sngi ka bakhatsaw jong u bnai, ha ka por janmiet ha ki pyntha ka Jerikho.
Ynda kum lashai hadien ka Paskha, ha kata hi ka sngi, ki la ïabam ïa ka jynbam kaba na kata ka ri, ïa ki kpu bakhlem thiat bad ïa u shira.
Te kum lashai, u manna u la sangeh namarba ki la ïabam ïa ka jynbam kaba na kata ka ri. Kumta ki paid Israel kim ïoh manna shuh, bad ki la hap bam katba ïoh na ri Kanaan ha kata ka snem.

Haba u Joshwa u la don hajan Jerikho, u la khmied ïa la ki khmat bad u la ïohi uwei u briew uba ïeng hakhmat jong u, u da bat ka waitlam lymbuit ha ka kti jong u. Hangta u Joshwa u la leit hajan jong u, u da kylli artat, “Hato phi don ha ka liang jong ngi, ne bad ki nongshun jong ngi?”

Te u la jubab, “Nga la wan kum u rangbah jong ka kynhun shipai u Trai.” Markumta u Joshwa u la dem pyllup ha khyndew bad u la mane ïa u, u da ong artat, “Aïu u kynrad jong nga u hukum ïa u shakri jong u?”

Kumta u rangbah shipai jong ka kynhun shipai u Trai u la ong ha u Joshwa, “ to loit noh ïa ki juti jong phi na ki kjat jong phi, namar kane ka jaka ba phi ïeng ka long ka bakhuid.” Bad u Joshwa u la kohnguh.
Mynta ïa ka Jerikho la khang na shapoh bad na shabar na ka daw ki Israel. Ym shym don shuh ba mih shabar ne ba rung shapoh.
Te u Trai U la kren ha u Joshwa, “Peit, Nga la ai ha ka kti jong phi ïa ka Jerikho, ïa u syiem jong ka bad ïa ki rangbah ïaleh ki bakhlaiñ bor.
Phi bad ki rangbah ïaleh baroh phin ïaid shisien baroh sawdong ka nongbah. Phin leh kumne hynriew sngi lynter.
Hynñiew ngut ki lyngdoh kiba kieng ïa ki turoi reng blang kin ïaid hakhmat ka synduk; te ha ka sngi ka bahynñiew phin ïaid tawiar ka nongbah hynñiew sien, ki lyngdoh kin put artat ïa ki turoi.

Haba ki put jlan da ki reng blang, u paid baroh un risa da ka jingrisa ka bajam, tang shu ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ki turoi. Hangta ka kynroh jong ka nongbah kan twa haduh ba yn da madan bad ka khyndew, bad uwei pa uwei u rangbah jong u paid un tur sia beit beit shakhmat.”

Kumta u Joshwa, u khun u Nun, u la khot ïa ki lyngdoh bad u la ong ha ki, “To shim bah ïa ka synduk ka jutang, bad sa hynñiew ngut pat ki lyngdoh kin kieng hynñiew tylli ki turoi da ki reng blang bad kin ïaid hakhmat ka synduk u Trai.”
U la ïathuh pat sa ïa u paidbah, “Khie ïaid shakhmat; ïaid sawdong ka nongbah, hynrei ai ki rangbah ba kieng atiar kin ïaid hakhmat ka synduk u Trai.”

Te kumba u Joshwa u la hukum ïa u paidbah, ki lyngdoh hynñiew ngut kiba kieng ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki turoi reng blang ki la ïaid shakhmat, ki put artat ïa ki turoi, bad ka synduk jong ka jutang u Trai ka bud nadien jong ki.
Ki rangbah kieng atiar ki la leit shakhmat ki lyngdoh kiba put turoi, bad ki rangbah ba ïada nadien ki la bud ïa ka synduk, katba ki turoi ki riew khlem sangeh.

Hynrei u Joshwa u la ai hukum ïa u paidbah, “Phim dei ban pyrta ne pynïohsngew ïa ka sur jong phi, ne wat pynmih kano kano ka ktien na ka shyntur jong phi, haduh ba yn da poi ka sngi ba ngan phah ïa phi ban pyrta; te hangta phin sa ïapyrta.”
Kumta ïa ka synduk u la pynïaid tawiar ïa ka nongbah, da kaba ïaid sawdong ïa ka shisien; nangta ki la wan phai sha ïing dara bad ki la sah shi miet ha ïing dara.
Dang step phyrngab u Joshwa u la khie bad ki lyngdoh ki la bah ïa ka synduk u Trai.

Ki hynñiew ngut ki lyngdoh, kiba kieng ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki turoi reng blang hakhmat ka synduk u Trai, ki la ïaid shakhmat, ki put artat ïa ki turoi khlem sangeh; bad ki rangbah kieng atiar ki la ïaid hakhmat jong ki, ki rangbah ba ïada nadien ki la bud nadien ka synduk u Trai, katba ki turoi pat ki put khlem sangeh.
Ha ka sngi ba-ar ki la ïaid tawiar ïa ka nongbah sa shisien, nangta ki wan phai sha ïing dara. Kumne shi kumne ki la leh hynriew sngi lynter.

Ha ka sngi bahynñiew ki la khie dang step tang shu kynjat shai, bad ki la ïaid tawiar ïa ka nongbah ha kajuh ka rukom hynñiew sien. Tang ba ha kane ka sngi ki la ïaid tawiar ïa ka nongbah hynñiew sien.
Te ha ka sien ka bahynñiew, haba ki lyngdoh ki la put ïa ki turoi, u Joshwa u la ong ha u paidbah, “Pyrta, namar u Trai U la ai ha phi ïa ka nongbah.

“Ïa ka nongbah bad baroh katba don hapoh jong ka yn sa aiti ha u Trai na ka bynta ka jingpynjot. Tang ka Rahab ka nuti bad baroh kiba don bad ka ha ïing jong ka kin im, namar ka la buhrieh ïa ki nongrah khubor ba ngi la phah.
Hynrei to kiar ïa lade na kiei kiei ba la mang ban pynjot, ïoh haba phi rah ïa kano kano ka tiar ba la mana phi ai daw ba ka dara Israel kan shah pynjot, bad kumta phin wah rah jingjynjar ïa ka.
Kumta ka rupa bad ka ksiar baroh, ki khiew rnong bad ki khiew nar baroh ki long kiba la aiti kyntang ha u Trai. Kine baroh kin leit sha ka jynkynshew u Trai.”

Kumta ki paidbah ki la pyrta bad ïa ki turoi la put. Ki paidbah ki tang shu ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ka turoi ki la kyrkait jam bad ka kynroh ka la twa haduh ban da madan lin bad ka kyndew. Hangta u paidbah u la leit rung hapoh ka nongbah, katba ki rangbah ki la tur beit beit shakhmat bad ki la knieh artat ïa ka nongbah.
Nangta ki la pynklo pom ïa ka nongbah baroh kawei. Ki la pom shynrang bad kynthei, samla bad tymmen, masi, blang bad kada da ka waitlam.

Hadien kata u Joshwa u la phah ïa kito ki rangbah ar ngut kiba la leit syntiat ïa ka ri, “Khie leit sha ka ïing jong ka nuti bad ïalam shabar ïa ka kynthei bad ïa kito baroh kiba ïadei kur bad ka, kumba phi la kular ha ka.”

Kumta ki samla kiba la leit syntiat, ki la leit rung bad ki la ïalam shabar ïa ka Rahab, ïa u kpa, ïa ka kmie, ïa ki hynmen shynrang jong ka bad ïa kiba ïadei kur bad ka baroh. Ki la ïalam ïa ki kur ki jait jong ka bad ki la pynshong ïa ki shabar ka dara ki Israel.
Nangta ki la wiang ding ïa ka nongbah bad ïa kiei kiei kiba don ha ka. Tang ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar, ïa ki khiew rnong bad ki khiew nar ki la buh ha ka jynkynshew u Trai.

Hynrei u Joshwa u la pyllait im tang ïa ka Rahab nuti, ïa kiba ha ïing ha sem jong ka bad ïa kiba ïadei kur bad ka. Haduh kane ka sngi, ka dang shong ha Israel namarba ka la pynrieh ïa ki nongrah khubor ba la phah syntiat u Joshwa ïa ka Jerikho.

U Joshwa u la khlei ïa ka jingtim hakhmat jong ki ha kata ka por, u da ong, “Un long uba la tim hakhmat u Trai uta u briew uba nud ban tei biang ïa kane ka nongbah Jerikho. Uban buh nongrim ïa ka, un duh ïa la u khun phrangsngi uban pynïeng ïa ki khyrdop jong ka, un duh ïa la u khun khatduh.
Kumta u Trai U la don bad u Joshwa, bad ka nam jong u ka la phriang kylleng ka ri.

Hynrei u paid Israel u la pynkheiñ jutang shaphang kiei kiei ba la aiti kyntang; namar u Akhan, u khun u Karmi, u khun u Zabdi, u khun u Zera, na ka jait Juda, u la shim katto katne ki mar ba la aiti, bad u Trai U la meh ding lep da ka jingbitar ïa u paid Israel.
U Joshwa u la phah briew na Jerikho sha Ai, kaba hajan Beth-Aben, sha mihngi na Bethel, bad u la ong ha ki, “Khie leit syntiat ïa kata ka ri.” Bad kito ki briew ki la leit syntiat ïa ka Ai.

Kita ki briew ki la wan phai sha u Joshwa bad ki la ïathuh ïa u, “Wat phah kiew baroh u paid, hynrei phah leit tang kumba ar ne lai hajar ngut ban ïaleh ïa ka Ai. Wat pynshitom ïa u paid baroh ban leit hangta, namar kim da bun briew.”
Kumba lai hajar ngut ki la leit kiew na u paid, hynrei ki la phet ïap nakhmat ki nong Ai.

Ki nong Ai ki la ïoh pynïap kumba laiphew hynriew ngut na ki, ki la beh nadien jong ki naduh ka khyrdop haduh Shebarim, bad ki la pynïap ïa ki ha sharing lum. Hangta ki dohnud jong ki paidbah ki la tlor bad ki la kylla kum ka um.
Te u Joshwa u la kad ïa la ki jaiñ, bad u la dem pyllup ha khyndew hakhmat ka synduk u Trai haduh ynda noh ka sngi. Ma u bad ki tymmen ki san Israel ki la ber da u khyndew ïa la ki khlieh.
U Joshwa u la ong, “Adur lanot, ko Trai ko Blei, balei Me la ïalam ïa une u paid sha shiliang ka Jordan, ban aiti ïa ngi ha ki kti ki Amor, ban pynïap ïa ngi? Lah ba shong sha lyndet ka Jordan!
A Trai, aïu pat ngan dang nang ban ong, haba ki Israel ki la kynran dien hakhmat ki nongshun jong ki!

Ki nong Kanaan bad ki trai shnong ka ri kin sa ïohsngew shaphang kane, kin sa ker tawiar ïa ngi bad kin sa pynduh ïa ka kyrteng jong ngi na ka khyndew. Aïu Men leh na ka bynta ka kyrteng bakhraw jong Me?”
U Trai U la ong ha u Joshwa, “Ïeng joit, balei phi la dem pyllup?

Ki Israel ki la leh pap. Ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang jong Nga kaba Nga la hukum ïa ki. Ki la shim katto katne kiei kiei kiba la aiti kyntang, ki la tuh, ki la lamler bad ki la buh lang bad ki tiar ki tar jong ki.

Namar kane u paid Israel um lah ban shan hakhmat ki nongshun jong ki. Ki la phai dien na ki nongshun jong ki namar ki la kylla kum kiba dei ban jot. Ngan ym don shuh bad phi tat haduh ba phin da pynduh napdeng jong phi ïa kiei kiei kiba la mana.

Ïeng joit, to pynkhuid ïa ki paidbah bad to ong, ‘To pynkhuid ïa lade lashai, namarba u Trai u Blei jong phi U ong kumne, “Don kiei kiei ba la mana hapdeng jong phi, ko Israel. Phin ym lah ban ïeng hakhmat ki nongshun jong phi, lymda phi weng noh napdeng jong phi ïa kiei kiei ba la mana”

Mynstep namarkata phin ïawan hajan shi jait shi jait; ka jait pat kaba u Trai Un ai dak kan wan hajan shi kur shi kur; ka kur pat kaba u Trai Un ai dak kan wan hajan shi ïing shi ïing, bad ka ïing pat kaba u Trai U ai dak kan wan hajan uwei u wei u briew.
Ïa uta uba la shim ïa kiei kiei kiba la khang yn thang da ka ding, ma u bad baroh kaba u don, namarba u la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang u Trai bad u la leh kaei kaei kaba pynjah burom ïa u Israel.’ ”
Kumta u Joshwa u la khie dang step bad u la ïalum ïa ki Israel shi jait shi jait, bad ïa ka jait Juda la ai dak.
Kumta u la ïalam ïa ki ïing ki sem Juda, bad ïa ka ïing ka sem jong ki Zera la ai dak; nangta pat u la wanlam ïa ka ïing ka sem ki Zera marwei marwei, ïa u Zabdi la ai dak.
Te u la wanlam ïa kiba ha ïing ha sem jong uwei pa uwei, bad ïa u Akhan, u khun u Karmi, u khun u Zabdi, u khun u Zera na ka jait Juda, la ai dak.
Kumta u Joshwa u la ong ha u Akhan, “Ko khun jong nga, to ai burom ïa u Trai, u Blei ki Israel, bad to ïaroh ïa U. To ïathuh ïa nga ïa kaba phi la leh; wat set ei ei na nga.”
Bad u Akhan u la jubab ïa u Joshwa, “Da shisha nga la leh pap pyrshah u Trai u Blei ki Israel, bad nga la leh kumne:

haba nga la ïohi hapdeng ki mar kliarwait kawei ka barandi ka ba-itynnat na Shinar, arspah shekel ka rupa, bad shi lyngkhot ka ksiar kaba khia sanphew shekel, nga la ikwah ïa ki, nga la shim ïa ki bad da shisha nga la buhrieh hapoh khyndew ha ka ïing jaiñ jong nga, bad ka rupa de hapoh.”
Kumta u Joshwa u la phah mareh da ki briew sha ka ïing jaiñ, bad da shisha ïa ka mar la buhrieh bad ka rupa hapoh ka ïing jaiñ jong u.
Te ki la sei ïa ki na ka ïing jaiñ bad ki la wan rah sha u Joshwa bad u paid Israel baroh, bad ki la siang ïa ki hakhmat u Trai.

Hangta u Joshwa bad ki Israel baroh ki la shim ïa u Akhan khun u Zera, lem bad ka rupa, ka barandi bad ka ksiar shi lyngkhot, ïa ki khun jong u, shynrang bad kynthei, ïa ki masi, ki kada bad ki ’langbrot, ïa ka ïing jaiñ jong u bad baroh katba u don, bad ki la ïalam ïa ki sha ka Them Akhor.

U Joshwa u la kren, “Balei phi wan rah jingjynjar halor jong ngi? U Trai U ai jingjynjar ïa phi mynta ka sngi.” Ki Israel baroh ki la lynthem ïa u da ki maw; ki la thang ïa ki sa da ka ding, bad ki la lynthem sa lynthem ïa ki da ki maw.
Halor jong u ki la tei shi kynton ki maw kiba dang don haduh kane ka sngi, bad hangta u Trai U sa jem ka jingbitar jong U. Kumta haduh kane ka sngi ïa ka kyrteng kata ka jaka la khot ka Them Akhor.

Te u Trai U la kren ha u Joshwa, “Wat sheptieng, wat khaw-eit. To shim bad phi baroh ki ’riewïaleh, khie leit kiew sha Ai. Phin ïohi ba Nga la aiti ha ka kti jong phi ïa u syiem Ai, ïa u paid jong u, ïa ka nongbah jong u bad ïa ka ri jong u.

Phin sa leh ïa ka Ai bad ïa u syiem jong ka kumba phi la leh ïa ka Jerikho bad u syiem jong ka, tang ba phin shim ei ïa lade kum ka jinglute ïa ki mar kliarwait bad ïa ki jynri jong ka. Ap thap ïa ka nongbah na shadien jong ka.”
Kumta u Joshwa bad ki ’riewïaleh baroh ki la ïeng ban leit kiew sha Ai. U Joshwa u la jied laiphew hajar ngut ki ’riewshlur ki bakhlaiñ bad u la phah sor ïa ki shimiet shimiet.
U la hukum ïa ki, “Peit, phi dei ban ap thap ïa ka nongbah na shadien jong ka. Wat jngai eh na ka nongbah hynrei pynkhreh bha ïa lade.
Nga pat, bad ki paid baroh kiba bad nga ngin tur shajan ka shnong. Lada ki wan tur pyrshah ïa ngi, kum mynshuwa, ngin phet na ki.
Hangta kin beh sia nadien jong ngi haduh ba ngin da jngai bak na ka nongbah, namar kin pyrkhat, ‘Ki la phet na ngi kum mynshuwa.’ Kumta ngin phet sa phet na ki.
Markumta ma phi phin mih bluit na ki ktem rieh, bad phin dakhol ïa ka nongbah, namar u Trai u Blei jong phi Un ai ïa ka ha ki kti jong phi.
Haba phi la dakhol ïa ka nongbah, wiang ding artat ïa ka, bad leh kumba u Trai U la hukum. Kynmaw ba nga la hukum ïa phi.”
Kumta u Joshwa u la phah bak ïa ki, bad ki la leit sha ka ktem rieh kaba don hapdeng Bethel bad Ai, shaphang sepngi ka Ai. Ha kata ka miet u Joshwa u la don bad ki paidbah.
Kum lashai u la khie dang step phyrngap bad u la lum lang ïa ki paidbah, nangta ma u hakhmat ki paidbah u la leit kiew bad ki tymmen ki san sha Ai.
Ki ’riewthma baroh kiba don bad u ki la leit kiew haduh hakhmat ka nongbah, bad ki la sher dara na ka liang kaba shaphang shatei ka Ai, ha kaba don ka riat hapdeng jong ki bad ka Ai.
Nangta u la shim san hajar ngut ki rangbah bad u la phah ap ktem ïa ki hapdeng Bethel bad Ai na shaphang sepngi ka nongbah.
Ki la buh shipai kumne: ka kynhun ka baheh eh ka ap shatei ka nongbah, bad ka kynhun kaba nadien shaphang sepngi ka nongbah. U Joshwa pat de u la sah miet ha them.

Haba u syiem Ai u la ïohi ïa kane, ma u, u paid jong u lem bad ki rangbah na shnong, ki la mih bak bak bad ki la wan sha ranab lum shaphang Araba ban ïaleh thma bad ki Israel. Um shym tip satia ïa ka jingpynap ktem pyrshah ïa u kaba na shadien ka nongbah.
U Joshwa bad ki Israel ki la leh mynleh shah rem hakhmat jong ki bad ki la phet sha ki thaiñ ri kynjah.
Kumta ki la khot ïa ki rangbah baroh kat kiba dang don ha shnong ban ïabeh lang nadien jong ki. Katba ki nangbeh ïa u Joshwa katta ki nang pajih na shnong.
Ym shym sah shuh ha Ai ne ha Bethel wat uwei u rangbah ubym shym beh nadien ki Israel. Ki la ieh noh rynghang ïa ka shnong bad ki la beh sia shi sia nadien ki Israel.

Hangta u Trai U la kren ha u Joshwa, “Rah shajrong shaphang Ai ïa u ’namsum uba don ha ka kti jong phi, namar Ngan ai ïa ka ha ki kti jong phi.” Te u Joshwa u la rah shajrong shaphang ka nongbah ïa u ’namsum uba la don ha ka kti jong u.

Markumta kita kiba ap ktem ki la mih na la ki jaka jaka, tang shu ïohi ba u rah ïa la ka kti shajrong. Ki la mareh bad ki la rung hapoh ka shnong, ki dakhol artat ïa ka, nangta ki wiang ding shisyndon ïa ka nongbah.

Haba ki nong Ai ki la phai dien, wow, ka tdem na ka nongbah ka la kiew sha suiñ bneng, hynrei kim don bor shuh ban beh shane ne shatai, namar ki paid kiba la phet sha ri kynjah ki beh kylla nadien ïa ki nongbeh.
Haba u Joshwa bad ki Israel baroh ki la ïohi ba kiba ap ktem ki la knieh ïa ka nongbah, bad ba ka tdem na ka nongbah ka la kiew, hangta ki la phai kylla bad ki la pom ïa ki briew jong ka Ai.

Sa kiwei pat ki la mih na nongbah pyrshah ïa ki. Hangta ki la hap lynshop hapdeng ki Israel, kiwei na kawei ka liang, kiwei pat na kawei pat ka liang. Ki Israel ki la pom ïap ïa ki, haduh ba ym sah im ne lait im wat uwei u briew ruh.
Hynrei ïa u syiem ka Ai ki la shu kem im bad ki la wan ïalam sha u Joshwa.

Haba ki Israel ki la dep pynïap lut ïa ki trai shnong Ai kiba la leit beh ïa ki ha ri kynjah haduh ba baroh phoiñ ki la kyllon da ka waitlam, ki Israel ki la wan phai baroh sha Ai bad ki la pynïap ïa ki paid baroh da ka waitlam.
Kiba la kyllon baroh ha kata ka sngi, shynrang bad kynthei, ki la long khat-ar hajar ngut, tang ki nong Ai suda.
U Joshwa um shym pynhiar ïa la ka kti kaba kdew shajrong da u ’namsum haduh ba u la pynjot ïa ki trai shnong baroh jong ka Ai.
Ki Israel ki la rah ïa lade kum ka jinglute tang ïa ki jynri bad ki mar kliarwait, kumba la hukum da u Trai ha u Joshwa.
Kumta u Joshwa u la thang ïa ka Ai da ka ding, bad u la pynlong ïa ka ka kynton jingjot shi junom haduh mynta mynne.

U la phasi ïa u syiem ha uwei u dieng haduh ynda janmiet, bad ynda la sep ka sngi, u Joshwa u la hukum ban pynhiar ïa ka met ïap jong u na u dieng bad ki la bret ïa ka ha khyrdop shnong. Ki la tei halor jong ka shi kynton ki maw kiba dang sah haduh kane ka sngi.
Nangta u Joshwa u la tei halor u lum Ebal ka duwan ha u Trai u Blei ki Israel,

“Ka duwan da ki maw ba khlem shniah ïa kiba ym shym la pyndei tiar nar da u briew”, katkum ka hukum u Moses u shakri u Trai ïa ki paid Israel, ïa kaba la thoh ha ka kitab aiñ jong u. Ki la tyrwa halor jong ka ki jynkñia thang ha u Trai, bad ki la kñia ki jyntyrwa ïabha ïamiat.
Hangta hakhmat u paid Israel baroh, u la thoh shisien bud halor ki maw ïa ka aiñ kaba u Moses u la thoh.

Te baroh ki Israel, ki soh shnong bad ki trai shnong, ryngkat bad ki tymmen ki san, ki rangbah treikam, bad ki nongbishar, ki la ïeng baroh ar liang ka synduk hakhmat ki lyngdoh Lebi kiba la bah ïa ka synduk ka jutang jong u Trai. Shiteng na ki ki la phai khmat sha u lum Gerizim bad shiteng sha u lum Ebal, kumba u Moses u shakri u Trai u la hukum naduh basdang, ba kin dup kyrkhu ïa u paidbah Israel.
Nadien kata u la pule ïa ki ktien baroh jong ka aiñ, ïa ka jingkyrkhu bad ka jingtim, kumba la thoh baroh ha ka kitab jong ka aiñ.
Ym shym don wat kawei ka kyntien na ka hukum baroh jong u Moses ïa kaba U Joshwa um shym pule hakhmat kata ka jingïalang jong ki Israel, bad kynthei bad khynnah, bad ki soh shnong kiba sah bad ki.

Haba ki syiem baroh kiba sha palat Jordan ha ri lum bad ri them ter ter ka ryngkew jong ka Duriaw Bakhraw shaphang Lebanon, ki Hit, ki Amor ki Kanaan, ki Peris, ki Hib, bad ki Jebus ki la ïohsngew ïa kane,
ki la teh lok lang da kawei ka jingthmu ban ïaleh ïa u Joshwa bad ki Israel.
Hynrei haba ki nong Gibeon ki la ïohsngew ïa kaba u Joshwa u la leh ïa ka Jerikho bad ka Ai,
ki la leh sianti. Ki la mih bad ka bam ka dih ba la pynbiang, ki pynkit ha ki kada da ki byrni jot, bad ki pla snieh thep waiñ kiba la pei bad syrdep,
ki phong ki juti kiba la jot ba la shu syrdep, bad ki sopti ruh kiba la kad. Baroh ka jynbam jong ki ka la tyrkhong bad ka la bthuh.
Te ki la leit sha u Joshwa ha ka dara ha Gilgal, bad ki la ïathuh ïa u bad ïa ki Israel, “Ngi la wan na ka ri ka bajngai; kumta to mynta ïateh jutang bad ngi.”
Hynrei ki rangbah Israel ki la ong ha ki Hib, “Lehse phi dei kiba shong bad ngi; te kumno ngi lah ban ïateh jutang bad phi?”
Ki la ïathuh ïa u Joshwa, “Ngi long ki shakri jong phi.” Bad u Joshwa u la kylli ïa ki, “Phi kiei? Naei phi ïawan?”
Ki la jubab ïa u, “Ki shakri jong phi ki la wan na ka ri bajngai, namar ka nam u Trai u Blei jong phi. Ngi la ïohsngew ka jingïathuh briew shaphang ki jingleh jong U ha Ijipt,
shaphang ka jingleh jong U ïa ki syiem Amor ar ngut, u Sihon syiem Heshbon bad u Ok syiem Bashan, kiba shong ha Ashtaroth sha palat ka Jordan.

Kumta ki tymmen ki san bad ki trai shnong ka ri jong ngi ki la ong ha ngi, “Khie leit ïakynduh ïa ki, da rah jynbam jyndih artat ha lynti, bad ïathuh kumne, Ngi long ki shakri jong phi; to mynta ïateh jutang noh bad ngi.’
Une hangne u kpu jong ngi ban bam ha lynti. U dang syaid haba ngi rah na ïing ha ka sngi ba ngi mih ban wan sha phi. Hynrei ha peit, u la tyrkhong bad u la bthuh.
Kine ki pla snieh waiñ ki dang thymmai haba ngi pyndap ïa ki, hynrei ha peit ki la pei. Kine ki jaiñ ba ngi phong bad ki juti jong ngi ki la lut ba jngai eh ka lynti.”
Kumta ki rangbah ki la ïabam ïa ki jynbam jong ki, ki khlem da wad jingpynshai na u Trai.
Te u Joshwa u la ïasuk bad ki, bad u la ïateh jutang ban shah ïa ki ban im, bad ki nongïalam jong u paidbah ruh ki la smai ha ki.
Lai sngi hadien ba ki la dep ïateh jutang, ki la ïohsngew ba ki dei pynban ki para marjan marpa jong ki bad ba ki shong ki sah bad ki.
Hangta ki paid Israel ki la leit bak bak haduh shnong jong ki hadien lai sngi. Ki nongbah jong ki dei ka Gibeon, ka Shephira, ka Beeroth, bad ka Kiriath-Jearim.
Hynrei ki paid Israel kim shym pynïap ïa ki namarba ki nongïalam jong u paidbah ki la lah kular ha ki da u Trai u Blei ka Israel. Te kumta u paidbah baroh u la khñium pyrshah ki nongïalam.
Ki nongïalam pat de ki la jubab ïa u paidbah, “Ngi la kular ha ki da u Trai u Blei ka Israel, kumta ngim lah shuh ban ktah kti ïa ki.
Ngin leh da kumne ïa ki. To ieh kin im, ïoh ka jingbitar kan wan halor jong ngi, namarba ngi la lah kular ha ki.”
Kumta ki nongïalam ki la ïathuh ïa ki, “Ieh kin mat im.” Tang ba kin long nongthoh dieng bad nongtong um ïa u paid baroh, kumba ki nongïalam ki la ïathuh ïa ki.
U Joshwa u la phah wan ïa ki bad u la ong ha ki, “Balei phi ïathuh shukor ïa ngi, ‘Ngi jngai na phi’, haba phi shong hapdeng jong ngi?
Namarkata la tim ïa phi mynta bad katto katne ngut na phi kin sa long junom ki mraw, ki nongthoh dieng bad ki nongtong um na ka bynta ka ïing jong u Blei jong nga.”

Te ki la ai jubab ïa u Joshwa, “Namar ba la ïathuh da kaba thikna ïa ki shakri jong phi ba u Trai u Blei jong phi U la hukum ïa u shakri jong U, u Moses, ban ai ha phi ïa kane ka ri baroh, bad ban pynjot ïa ki trai shnong baroh hakhmat jong phi, hangta ngi la sheptieng tyngeh ïa la ka jingim, bad ngi sa leh kumne.
Mynta, ha peit, ngi don ha ki kti jong phi. To leh ïa ngi kat kaba phi idei bad phi ibit ha ka jingpeit jong phi.”
Kumta u la leh kumne ïa ki. U la pyllait ïa ki na ki kti jong u paid Israel, bad kim shym pynïap ïa ki.

Hynrei u Joshwa u la pynlong ïa ki naduh kata ka sngi ki nongthoh dieng bad ki nongtong um na ka bynta u paidbah bad na ka bynta ka duwan jong u Trai, haduh kane ka sngi, ha ka jaka ba u Trai U la jied.

Haba u Adonisedek, u syiem Jerusalem, u la ïohsngew kumno u Joshwa u la jop ïa ka Ai bad u la pynjot thiaw ïa ka, u da leh ïa ka Ai bad ïa u syiem jong ka kumba u la leh ïa ka Jerikho bad ïa u syiem jong ka, bad nangta pat kumno ki nong Gibeon ki la ïasuk bad ki Israel bad ki la im lang sah lang bad ki,
u la sngewtieng jur namar ka Gibeon ka dei ka nongbah ka bakhraw, kum kawei na ki nongbah syiem, bad ka kham heh artat ban ïa ka Ai, nalor ba ki rangbah jong ka baroh ki dei ki ’riewïaleh.
Kumta u Adonisedek u syiem Jerusalem u la phah ktien sha u Hoham u syiem Hebron, u Piram, u syiem Jarmuth, sha u Japhia u syiem Lakhish, bad sha u Debir u syiem Eglon, u ong kumne.
“Ale wan ïarap lem ïa nga ban ïuh roit ïa ka Gibeon namar ka la leit ïateh lok teh jor bad u Joshwa bad ki paid Israel.”

Hangta san ngut ki syiem Amor, u syiem Jerusalem, u syiem Hebron, u syiem Jarmuth, bad u syiem Eglon, ki la ïalum shipai lum swar, ki la leit tur bad la ki shipai baroh, ki la ker tawiar ïa ka Gibeon bad ki la ïaleh thma ïa ka.

Te ki rangbah Gibeon ki la phah khubor sha u Joshwa uba sher dara ha Gilgal, ki da ong, “Wat pynran ïa la ka kti na ki shakri jong phi. Ale kloi lan ban pyllait, ban ïarap ïa ngi, naba ki syiem Amor baroh kiba shong ha ri lum ki la ïalum pyrshah ïa ngi.”
Kumta u Joshwa u la leit kiew na Gilgal ryngkat bad ki ’riewïaleh bad ki ’riewkhlaiñ jong u baroh.
Te u Trai U la ong ha u Joshwa. “Wat tieng ïa ki, naba Nga la aiti ïa ki ha ki kti jong phi. Wat uwei na ki un ym lah ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi.”
Kumta u Joshwa u la wan hiar halor jong ki kyndit kyndit, hadien ba u la ïaid baroh shimiet na Gilgal.

Bad u Trai U la pynher krad ïa ki hakhmat ki Israel, kiba la pynïap ïa ki haban da suwan khait ha Gibeon. Ki la beh ïa ki nadien arsut ki ranab Bethoron, bad ki la ïaleh sa ïaleh ïa ki haduh Aseka bad Makkeda.

Te katba ki nangphet hakhmat ki Israel arsut ki ranab Bethoron, u Trai U la pynhap sa ki phria ki baheh na bneng halor jong ki haduh Aseka, bad ki la ïap. Kham bun ki la ïap na ki phria ban na ka waitlam jong ki Israel.
U Joshwa u la kren ha u Trai ha ka sngi ba U la aiti ïa ki Amor ha ki Israel. U la ong haba ïohi ki Israel, “Ko sngi, to sangeh ha Gibeon; me ruh, ko bnai, ha ka them Aijalon.”

Te ka sngi ka la ïeng thik, bad u bnai u la sangeh, haduh ba u paid u la pynhiar kput haban da biang ïa ki nongshun. Hato ym shym la thoh ïa kane ha ka Kitab u Jashar? Ka sngi ka la sangeh ha mar pdeng ka sahit bneng, bad kam shym kyrkieh ban sep lajan shisngi pura.
Ym pat ju don sngi kum kane mynshuwa ne naduh kata ka por, mynba u Trai U la shah shkor ïa ka sur jong u briew, namar u Trai U la ïaleh na ka bynta ki Israel.
Nangta u Joshwa u la wan phai sha ki jaka sher dara jong u ha Gilgal bad ki Israel baroh.
Kitei ki syiem san ngut ki la phet rieh ha ka krem ha Makkeda.
La wan ïathuh kumne ïa u Joshwa, “Ïa ki san ngut ki syiem la lap ba ki rieh ha ka krem ha Makkeda.”
Kumta u Joshwa u la ong, “Pyntyllun da ki maw ki baheh haduh khmat ka krem bad pynap pahara hajan jong ka da ki briew.

Phi ïa lade wat sah hangta, hynrei beh sia nadien ki nongshun jong phi kynrup ïa ki nadien, wat ai lad ba kin rung ha ki shnong jong ki, naba u Trai u Blei jong phi U la aiti ïa ki ha ki kti jong phi.”
Ynda u Joshwa bad ki paid Israel ki la dep pynïap ïa ki haban da lko pom, bad kiba lait ïap ki la ïoh rung hapoh ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh,
baroh ki paid ki la wan phai suk sha u Joshwa ha ka jaka sher dara ha Makkeda. Ym shym don wat uwei u briew uba la nud pyn-eh pyrshah ïa uno uno na ki Israel.
Nangta u Joshwa u la ong, “Pyllait ïa ka lynti krem, sei ïa ki syiem baroh san ngut bad wanlam ïa ki sha nga.”
Bad ki la leh kumta. Ki la wanlam ïa ki syiem san ngut napoh krem; u syiem Jerusalem, u syiem Hebron, u syiem Jarmuth, u syiem Lakhish, bad u syiem Eglon.

Te haba ïa kito ki syiem la wan ïalam sha u Joshwa, u Joshwa u la khot lang ïa ki paid Israel baroh, bad u la ong ha ki rangbah jong ki ’riewthma kiba la ïaleit bad u, “Ale hajan, ïuh da ki kjat na ki ryndang jong kine ki syiem.” Ki la ïawan hajan bad ki la ïuh da ki kjat ïa ki ryndang jong ki.
Nangta u Joshwa u la ong ha ki, “Wat tieng ne sngew khaw-eit; to long ki bakhlaiñ bad ki bashlur, naba ha kane ka rukom u Trai Un leh ïa ki nongshun kiba ïaleh ïa phi.”
Hadien kata u Joshwa u la pom ïa ki haduh ba kin da ïap bad u la sdien ïa ki halor ki san tylli ki dieng. La sdien ïa ki halor ki dieng haduh ynda janmiet.

Ynda la noh ka sngi ban sep, u Joshwa u la hukum ban pynhiar noh ïa ki na ki dieng, bad u la bret ïa ki ha ka krem ba ki la buhrieh ïa lade, bad ki la set da ki maw ki baheh ïa ka khmat jong ka krem, bad kine ki dang sah haduh kane ka sngi.

Ha kajuh hi ka sngi, u Joshwa u la jop ïa ka Makkeda, u la pynjot ïa ka bad ïa u syiem jong ka da ka waitlam. U la pynïap ïa ki briew baroh kiba don ha ka, u khlem pynsah wat uwei ruh. U la leh ïa u syiem Makkeda kumba u la leh ïa u syiem Jerikho.
Nangta u Joshwa bad ki paid Israel baroh ki la leit na Makkeda shaduh Libna bad ki la ïaleh sa ïa ka ruh.

U Trai U la aiti ïa ka bad ïa u syiem jong ka ha ki kti ki Israel. U Joshwa u la pom ïa ka da ka waitlam bad ïa ki briew baroh naphang. Um shym pynsah wat uwei ruh ha ka bad u la leh ïa u syiem jong ka kumba u la leh ïa u syiem Jerikho.
Na Libna u Joshwa bad ki paid Israel ki la leit sa sha Lakhish. Ki la kerkut ïa ka, ki la ïaleh ïa ka.
U Trai U la ai ïa ka Lakhish ha ki kti ki Israel. U Joshwa u la jop ïa ka ha ka sngi ka ba-ar bad u la pom ïa ka da ka waitlam bad ïa ki briew baroh kiba don ha ka, kumba u la leh ïa ka Libna.
U Horam u syiem Gezer u la wan ïarap ïa ka Lakhish, bad u Joshwa u la pom ïa u bad ïa ki paid jong u haduh ba ym shym sah shuh mano mano.
U Joshwa bad ki paid Israel ki la leit na Lakhish sha Eglon. Ki la kerkut bad ki la ïaleh ïa ka.
Ki la jop ïa ka ha kata hi ka sngi bad ki la pom ïa ka da ka waitlam. Ki la pynïap baroh ki briew kat kiba don ha ka ha kata ka sngi, kumba ki la leh ïa ka Lakhish.
Te u Joshwa bad ki paid Israel ki la leit na Eglon sha Hebron bad ki la ïaleh ïa ka.

Ki la jop ïa ka bad ki la pom da ka waitlam ïa u syiem bad ïa ki shnong jong ka, bad ïa ki briew baroh kiba don ha ka. Ki khlem pynsah shuh wat uwei ruh, kumba ki la leh ïa ka Eglon haba la pynlko pom ïa ka bad ïa ki briew baroh kiba don ha ka.
Nangta u Joshwa bad ki paid Israel baroh ki la wan phai dien sha Debir bad ki la ïaleh ïa ka.

Ki la jop ïa ka, ïa u syiem bad ïa ki shnong jong ka baroh. Ki la pom ïa ki da ka waitlam bad ki la pynïap baroh ki briew kiba don ha ka khlem pyllait im wat uwei ruh. Kumba ki la leh ïa ka Hebron bad ka Libna, kumta ruh ki la leh ïa ka Debir bad ïa u syiem jong ka.

Kumta u Joshwa u la jop thiaw ïa ka ri baroh kawei, ïa ka ri lum bad ka Nekeb, ïa ka ri them bad ïa ki ranab, bad ïa ki syiem jong ki baroh. Um shym pyllait im ïano ïano hynrei u la pynjot thiaw kat ïa uba don mynsiem, kumba u Trai u Blei ka Israel U la hukum.
Te u Joshwa u la jop ïa ki naduh Kadesh-barnea haduh Gaza, bad baroh ka ri Goshen haduh Gibeon.
U Joshwa u la jop ïa kine ki syiem baroh bad ïa ka ri jong ki tang shisien ïaleh, namarba u Trai u Blei ki Israel U la ïaleh na ka bynta jong ki.
Nadien nangta u Joshwa bad u paid Israel ki la wan phai sha ka jaka sher dara ha Gilgal.
Haba u Jabin, syiem Hazor, u la ïohsngew ïa kane, u la phah ktien sha u Jobab, syiem Madon, sha u syiem Shimron, bad sha u syiem Akshaph,
nangta sha ki syiem jong ka ri lum bashatei, sha Araba, shathie ka Khinneroth sha ki ri thor bad sha Naphotdor shaphang sepngi,
nangta sha ki nong Kanaan mihngi bad sepngi, sha ki nong Amor, ki nong Hit, ki nong Peris, bad ki nong Jebus kiba ha ri lum, bad sha ki nong Hib hapoh u Hermon ha ka ri Mizpa.
Te ki la ïawan mih bad la ki shipai shipai, u paid uba la kat u shyiap harud duriaw, lem bad bunbah ki kulai bad ki kali.
Baroh kine ki syiem ki la pynlong kawei ka kynhun shipai bad ki la sher dara lang ha ki um Merom ban ïaleh ïa ki Israel.

Kumta u Trai U la kren ha u Joshwa, “Wat sheptieng ïa ki. Lashai kum ha kane ka por Ngan aiti ïa ki baroh ha ki Israel. Phin thait ïa ki thied jong ki kulai jong ki bad phin thang ïa ki kali jong ki da ka ding.”
Kumta u Joshwa bad ki paid ïaleh jong u baroh ki la wan hiar kyndit kyndit halor jong ki hangta ha ki um Merom bad ki la ïaleh ïa ki.

Te u Trai U la aiti ïa ki ha ki kti ki Israel. Ki la pom ïa ki bad ki la beh ïa ki haduh ka Sidon Bakhraw bad ka Misrephoth-maim, bad sha mihngi haduh ka them Mizpa. Ki la pom ïa ki bad kim shym pyllait im wat uwei ruh.
Hangta u Joshwa u la leh kumba u Trai U la hukum ïa u. U la thait ïa ki thied jong ki kulai jong ki bad u la thang ïa ki kali jong ki da ka ding.
Ynda wan phai nangta ha kata ka por u Joshwa u la jop ïa ka Hazor bad u la pom ïa u syiem jong ka da ka waitlam. Mynshuwa ka Hazor ka la long ka rangbah duh jong kitei baroh ki hima.
Ki la pynïap baroh kat kiba don ha ka, ki da pynjot thiaw ïa ki. Ym shym pynsah mynsiem shuh ïano ïano bad ki la thang ïa ka Hazor da ka ding.
Te u Joshwa u la jop ïa ki nongbah jong kitei ki syiem bad ïa ki syiem jong ki baroh, u da pom ïa ki da ka waitlam haduh ba kin da lko pom, kumba u Moses u shakri jong u Trai u la hukum.
Ïa ki nongbah kiba don halor lum ki Israel kim shym thang da ka ding. Tang ïa ka Hazor u Joshwa u la thang.
Ki paid Israel ki la kit kum ka bai kliarwait kat kaba ki la ïoh knieh na ki nongbah bad ïa ki jynri jyndup baroh, hynrei ïa ki briew baroh ki la pom da ka waitlam, khlem pynsah ïano ïano ruh.
Kumba u Trai U la hukum ïa u Moses u shakri jong U, kumta ruh u Moses u la hukum ïa u Joshwa, bad u Joshwa pat u la leh ruh kumta. Um shym pynsah teng ei ei kat kaba u Trai U la hukum ïa u Moses.
Kumta u Joshwa u la jop ïa kata ka ri baroh, ïa ka ri lum, ïa ka Nekeb baroh ïa ka ri Goshen baroh, ïa ka ri them, ïa ka Araba bad ka ri lum Israel haduh ri them,
naduh lum Halak uba phai shaphang Seir haduh Baalkad ha them Lebanon, hapoh u lum Hermon. U la jop bad u la pom pynïap ïa ki syiem jong ki baroh.
U Joshwa u la ïaleh thma slem bad kitei ki syiem baroh.
Ym shym don kawei ka nongbah kaba la ïasuk bad ki paid Israel, lait tang ki Hib, ki trai shnong ka Gibeon. Ki la jop ïa ki baroh da ka thma.

Naba ka dei ka jingleh jong u Trai ban pyn-eh ïa ki dohnud jong ki khnang ba kin dup ïeng ïaleh thma pyrshah ki Israel, khnang ba yn dup ïoh pynjot thiaw ïa ki, khnang ba kin ym ïoh jingisynei hynrei ba kin shah pynduh jait artat, kumba u Trai U la hukum ïa u Moses.

Te ha kata ka por u Joshwa u la pynjot thiaw ïa ki Anakim na ri lum, na Hebron, na Debir, na Anab, bad na ka ri lum Juda baroh bad na ka ri Israel baroh. U Joshwa u la pynlko pom ïa ki bad ïa ki nongbah jong ki.
Ym shym sah ei ei na ki Anakim ha ka ri jong u paid Israel. Tang ha Gaza, ha Gath bad ha Ashdod dang sah katto katne.

Kumta u Joshwa u la jop ïa ka ri baroh kawei kumba u la ong u Trai ha u Moses, bad u Joshwa u la ai pateng ïa ka ha ki Israel, kumba la sam ïa ki shi jait shi jait. Kumta ka ri ka la shong thait na ka thma.
Ki syiem ïa kiba ki paid Israel ki la jop bad ki ri ïa kiba ki la dakhol ha lyndet ka Jordan naphang mihngi, na ka them Arnon haduh lum Hermon, kynthup lang ka Araba shaphang mihngi, dei kine:

u Sihon u syiem ki Amor uba la shong ha Heshbon, u la synshar naduh Aroer kaba ha thmit ka them Arnon, nangta napdeng ka them haduh wah Jabbok, ka pud jong ki Ammon, kata ka long, mar shiteng ka Gilead,
nangta shaphang mihngi na Araba shaduh ka Duriaw Shinneroth ter ter shaphang Beth-Jeshimoth shaduh ka Duriaw Araba ka Duriaw Mluh, arsut pat shaphang shathie shaduh kjat ki ranab Piska.
U Ok syiem Bashan, uwei na kiba dang im na Rephaim, uba la shong ha Ashtaroth bad ha Edrei,
u la synshar ïa u lum Hermon bad ka Saleka, baroh ka Bashan shaduh khap-pud ki Geshur bad ki Maakathis, bad marshiteng ka Gilead haduh markhap-pud bad u Sihon, u syiem Heshbon.
U Moses, u shakri u Trai, bad ki paid Israel ki la jop ïa ki. Te u Moses, u shakri u Trai, u la ai ïa ka ri jong ki ba kin buhai shnong ka jait Reuben, ka jait Gad bad shiteng ka jait Manasse.

Kine ki dei kiwei pat ki syiem jong ka ri ïa kiba u Joshwa bad ki paid Israel ki la jop shaphang sepngi ka Jordan, naduh Baal-Gad ha them Lebanon haduh u lum Halak uba phai shaphang Seir. U Joshwa te u la ai ïa ka ri jong ki ha ki jait Israel ban buhai shnong kumba la sam ïa ki,
ha ri lum bad ha ri them, ha Araba bad ha ranab lum ha ri kynjah bad ha Nekeb, ha ka ri jong ki Hit, ki Amor, ki Kanaan, ki Peris, ki Hib, bad ki Jebus.
Ki dei kine: u syiem ka Jerikho; u syiem ka Ai, kaba hajan Bethel;
u syiem ka Jerusalem; u syiem ka Hebron;
u syiem ka Jarmuth; u syiem ka Lakhish;
u syiem ka Eglon; u syiem ka Gezer;
u syiem ka Debir; u syiem ka Geder;
u syiem ka Horma; u syiem ka Arad;
u syiem ka Libna; u syiem ka Adullam;
u syiem ka Makkeda; u syiem ka Bethel;
u syiem ka Tappua; u syiem ka Hepher;
u syiem ka Aphek; u syiem ka Lasharon;
u syiem ka Madon; u syiem ka Hazor;
u syiem ka Shimronmeron; u syiem ka Akhshap;
u syiem ka Taanak; u syiem ka Megiddo;
u syiem ka Kedesh; u syiem ka Jokne-am, ha Karmel;
u syiem ka Dor, ha Naphathdor; u syiem ka Koi-im ha Galilea;
u syiem ka Tirza; baroh lang, laiphew wei ngut ki syiem.
Mynta u Joshwa u la tymmen bad u la bun ki snem, bad u Trai U la ong ha u, “Phi la tymmen bad la bun ki snem, hynrei dang bun bah ka ri ba dei ban dakhol.
Kane ka long ka ri kaba sah: baroh ki thaiñ jong ki Philistia, bad jong ki Geshur

(naduh Shihor sha mihngi ka Ijipt haduh khappud Ekron shaphang shatei, ka ri ba ju ñiew kum ka Kanaan. Don san ngut ki syiem Philistia, ki jong ka Gaza, ka Ashdod, ka Ashkelon, ka Gath bad ka Ekron), bad kito ki jong ka Abbim shaphang shathie.
Ka ri Kanaan baroh kawei naduh ka Meara kaba synshar ki nong Sidon, haduh Aphek, haduh khap-pud ki Amor,
nangta ki ri ki Gebal bad baroh ka Lebanon shaphang mihngi na Baal-Gad harum u lum Hermon haduh lynti Hamath.

Ïa ki trai shnong baroh jong ka ri lum naduh Lebanon haduh Misrephoth-maim, wat ïa ki nong Sidon baroh phar Ngan pynher krad hakhmat ki paid Israel. To ai ha ki Israel la ka bynta bynta kum ka nongkynti, kumba Nga la hukum ïa phi.
Mynta to sam noh ïa kane ka ri kum ka nongkynti hapdeng ki khyndai jait bad ka shiteng ka jait Manasse.”

Kawei pat ka shiteng ka jait Manasse, ka jait Reuben bad ka jait Gad ki la ïoh la ka nongkynti ba la ai ïa ki da u Moses shaphang mihngi sha lyndet ka Jordan. U Moses, u shakri u Trai, u la ai bynta ïa ki:
naduh Aroer kaba ha thmit ka them Arnon, ïa ka nongbah kaba hapdeng ka them, bad ïa ka kynjang lum Medeba baroh haduh Dibon;
ïa ki nongbah baroh jong u Sihon u syiem ki Amor uba la synshar ha Heshbon haduh khap-pud ki Ammon;
ïa ka Gilead bad ka ri ki Geshur bad ki Maakathis, ïa u lum Hermon bad ka Bashan baroh haduh Saleka;
ïa ka hima baroh jong u Ok ha Bashan, uba la synshar ha Ashtaroth bad ha Edrei (tang ma u marwei uba lait im ha Rephaim). Ïa kine baroh u Moses u la jop bad u la beh krad.
Pynban ki paid Israel kim shym la beh noh ïa ki Geshur ne ki Maakath bad haduh kane ka sngi ki dang shong hapdeng ki Israel.
Ïa ka jait Lebi marwei u Moses um shym ai bynta ei ei. Ki jingtyrwa da ka ding ha u Trai u Blei ki Israel ki long ka nongkynti jong ki, kumba U la ong ha u.
Te u Moses u la ai bynta ïa ka jait Reuben katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ki.
Kumta ka ri jong ki ka dei naduh Aroer kaba don ha thmit ka Them Arnon ka nongbah kaba hapdeng ka them bad ka kynjang lum kaba haduh Medeba;
nangta ka Heshbon bad ki nongbah baroh kiba ha ka kynjang lum; ka Dibon, ka Bamoth-baal bad ka Beth-Baal-Meon,
sa ka Jahas, ka Kedemoth bad ka Mepha-ath,
ka Kiriathaim, ka Sibma bad ka Zereth-Shahar halor lum jong ka them,
ka Beth-peor, ki ranab Piska bad ka Beth-Jeshimoth,

kata ka mut, ki nongbah baroh kiba ha kynjang lum, bad ka hima baroh kawei jong u Sihon, syiem ki Amor, uba la synshar ha Heshbon, ïa uba u Moses u la jop ryngkat bad ki syiem ka Midian, ka Ebi, ka Rekem, ka Zur, ka Hur bad ka Reba, kiba la shong hapoh ka khyndew u Sihon.
Ïa u Balaam, u khun u Deor, u nongleh byrtong, ki Israel ki la pynïap da ka waitlam ryngkat bad kiwei pat kiba la shah pynïap.
Ka pud jong ki paid Reuben dei ka Jordan. Kane ka la long ka bynta jong ki khun u Reuben, katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ki, bad ki nongrit bad ki nongheh.
Te u Moses u la ai bynta sa ïa ka jait Gad katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ki.
Ka ri jong ki ka la long ka Jazer bad baroh ki nongbah ka Gilead, bad shiteng na ka ri ki Ammon shaduh Aroer, kaba ha mihngi ka Rabba.
Nangta na Heshbon haduh Ramath-Mizpe bad Betonim, na Mahanaim haduh ka ri Debir,

bad nangta pat ha them ka Beth-Haram, ka Beth-nimra, ka Sukkoth bad ka Zaphon, kaba sah na ka hima u Sihon, syiem Heshbon, khap-pud ka Jordan sharum eh jong ka Duriaw Shinneroth shaphang mihngi sha lyndet ka Jordan.
Kane ka long ka jynai bynta ïa ki khun u Gad katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ki, lem bad ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki.
U Moses u la ai bynta ka shiteng ka jait Manasse; la ai ïa ka katkum ki ïing ki sem.
Ka ri jong ki ka ïar naduh Mahanaim, lyngba ka Bashan baroh kawei bad ka hima baroh jong u Ok syiem Bashan, bad baroh ki shnong jong u Jair kiba ha Bashan, hynriewphew tylli.

Nangta shiteng ka Gilead, ka Ashtaroth bad ka Edrei, ki nongbah jong u Ok ha Bashan. Ïa kine la ai bynta ha ki paid u Makhir, khun u Manasse, ïa kiba shiteng na ki khun u Makhir katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ki.
Kine ki long ki jynai pateng kiba u Moses u la sam ha ri thor Moab sha lyndet ka Jordan mihngi na Jerikho.
Hynrei u Moses um shym ai bynta ïa ka jait Lebi. U Trai u Blei ki Israel U dei ka bynta jong ki, kumba U la ong ha ki.

Kine ki long ki bynta ba ki paid Israel ki la ïoh kum ka nongkynti ha ri Kanaan, ïa kiba u Eleasar lyngdoh, bad u Joshwa, khun u Nun, lem bad ki rangbah jong ki ïing ki sem ki paid Israel ki la sam ïa ki.
Ki la sam bynta da kaba khalai nusip, kumba u Trai U la hukum ïa u Moses na ka bynta ki khyndai jait shiteng.
U Moses u la ai bynta ïa ki ar jait shiteng sha lyndet ka Jordan; hynrei um shym ai bynta ei ei ïa ki Lebi.

Ki paid u Joseph ki la long ar jait, u Manasse bad u Ephraim. Ïa ki khun u Lebi ym shym ai bynta ha ka ri, hynrei tang ki shnong ba kin shong lem bad ki khyndew pynbamphlang na ka bynta ki jynri bad ka kamai kajih jong ki.
Ki paid Israel ki la leh kumba u Trai U la hukum ïa u Moses ban sam bynta ïa ka ri.

Te ki paid Juda ki la wan sha u Joshwa ha Gilgal, bad u Kaleb, u khun u Jephunne uba na Kenis, u la ong ha u, “Phi tip aïu u Trai U la ong ha u Moses, u briew jong u Blei, ha Kadesh-barnea shaphang jong phi bad jong nga.
Nga la don sawphew snem ka ryta mynba u Moses, u shakri jong u Trai, u la phah ïa nga na Kadesh-barnea ban syntiat ïa ka ri, bad nga la wan rah khubor kumba don ha ka dohnud jong nga.
Hynrei ki para kiba la ïaleit bad nga ki la pyntlor ïa ka dohnud u paid, pynban ma nga nga la bud thik ïa ka mon u Trai u Blei jong nga.

Te u Moses u la kular kumne ha kata ka sngi, ‘Da shisha shisha ka ri ha kaba phi la ïuh kjat kan sa long ka nongkynti na ka bynta jong phi bad jong ki khun jong phi shi junom, namarba phi la bud thik ïa u Trai u Blei jong nga.’

Te mynta, hakhmih, u Trai U dang ri-im ïa nga, kumba U la ong, mynta sawphew san snem naduh ba u Trai U la kren ïa kane ka ktien ha u Moses, katba ki Israel ki dang ïaid ha ri kynjah. Nga mynta ka sngi nga la dap phraphew san snem ka ryta.
Nga dang khlaiñ haduh kane ka sngi kum ha kato ka sngi ba u Moses u la phah ïa nga. Ka bor jong nga mynta ka long kum ha kato ka por na ka bynta ka thma, bad ban leit ban wan.

Kumta to ai ïa nga mynta ïa kane ka ri lum ïa kaba u Trai U la kren ha kato ka sngi. Phi la ïohsngew ha kata ka sngi ba ki Anakim ki la shong hangta, ba ki don ki nongbah ïa kiba ki la tei kynroh. Lada u Trai U don bad nga, ngan sa beh krad ïa ki kumba u Trai U la ong.”
Te u Joshwa u la kyrkhu ïa u bad u la ai ïa ka Hebron ha u Kaleb, u khun u Jephunne, kum ka nongkynti.
Kumta ka Hebron ka la kylla long ka nongkynti u Kaleb, u khun u Jephunne uba na Kenis, haduh kane ka sngi, namarba u la kohnguh thik ïa u Trai u Blei ka Israel.
Ka kyrteng jong ka Hebron mynshuwa ka dei Kiriath-arba. U Arba u la long u briew u bakhraw tam hapdeng ki Anakim. Bad ka ri ka la ïoh shong thait na ka thma.
Ka bynta ïa u paid na ka jait Juda katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ki ka la ïar shaduh khap Edom shaphang shathie, ka poi haduh ka ri kynjah Zin ha bakut shaphang shathie.
U pud uba shaphang shathie u la sdang na tduh jong ka Duriaw Mluh, hamar ka kyndong um kaba phai khmat shaphang shathie.
Ka bud arsut nangta ïa u thiep Akrabbim, ka pom lyngba ïa ka Zin, sa artet ban noh shathie na Kadesh-barnea najan Hesron haduh Addar, sa phai pat sha Karka.
U tawiar ïa ka Azmon, u mih hamar ka wah duid Ijipt bad u kut ha duriaw. Une u pud jong phi na shaphang shathie.
U pud na sha mihngi dei ka Duriaw Mluh haduh khmat ka Jordan. U pud pat uba na shatei u sdang na kyndong um duriaw hakhmat ka Jordan.
Nangne u pud u kiew sha Bethokla, u kiew shaphang shatei ka Beth-araba, bad u kiew haduh u Maw jong u Bohan, u khun u Rueben.

U pud nangta u kiew sha Debir na ka Them Akhor, bad kumta u phai shatei shaphang Gilgal kaba mar pyrshah u thiep Adummim, kaba don shaphang shathie jong ka them. Nangne u pud u leit shaduh ki um En-shemesh bad u kut ha Enrogel.

Nangta u pud u kiew na ka them jong u khun u Hinnom ha ka krung kaba shaphang shathie jong ki Jebus (kata ka mut, ka Jerusalem) bad u kiew artet sha kliar u lum uba ïeng mar pyrshah ka them u Hinnom shaphang sepngi ha ka tduh kaba shatei eh jong ka them Rephaim.
Na kliar lum u pud u phai shaphang tlong jong ki Um Neptoa, bad nangta shaduh ki nongbah u lum Ephron. Sa nangta u pud u khun sawdong sha Baala (kata ka mut, ka Kiriath-Jearim).
U pud u tawiar shuh sha sepngi ka Baala sha u lum Seir, u ïaid beit beit sha ka tyrpeng kaba shatei jong u lum Jearim (kata ka mut, ka Khesalon), bad u sa hiar sha Beth-shemesh, ter ter najan Timna.
U pud ynda u la poi ha krung jong u lum rit shatei ka Ekron, u khun sawdong sha Shikkeron bad u poi haduh u lum Baala, nangta sha Jabneel bad u kut artat ha duriaw.
U pud na sepngi dei ka Duriaw Bakhraw bad ka rud duriaw. Une u long u pud sawdong u paid Juda katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ki.
Katkum ka hukum jong u Trai ha u Joshwa, u la ai ha u Kaleb, u khun u Jephunne, ka bynta kaba hapdeng ki paid u Juda, ka Kiriath-arba, kata ka mut, ka Hebron, (u Arba u la long u kpa jong u Anak).
Te u Kaleb u la beh krad nangta ïa ki khun jong u Anak lai ngut, u Sheshal, u Ahman bad u Talmai, ki khun pateng u Anak.
Nangta u la leit ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki trai shnong Debir; mynshuwa ïa ka Debir la khot kyrteng Kiriath-sepher.
U Kaleb u la ong, “Kat uba jop bad ïoh knieh ïa ka Kiriath-sepher, ngan ai ha u ïa ka Aksa, ka khun jong nga, ban long ka tnga jong u.”
Te u Othniel, u khun u Kenas, shipara bad u Kaleb, u la ïoh knieh ïa ka, bad u la ai ïa ka Aksa, ka khun kynthei jong u, ban long ka tnga jong u.
Haba ka la wan sha u, ka la kyntu ïa u ban pan kawei ka lyngkha na u kpa jong ka. Te ka la hiar na ka kada jong ka bad u Kaleb u la kylli ïa ka, “Aïu phi kwah?”
Te ka la jubab, “To ai ïa nga ruh kawei ka jingai sngewbha. Namarba phi la ai ïa nga sha ka ri Nekeb, ai ruh sa ki umpohliew.” Bad u Kaleb u la ai ïa ka ki umpohliew kiba shaneng bad sharum.
Kane ka long ka jingai bynta ïa ka jait jong ki paid Juda katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ki.
Ki nongbah kiba dei jong ki paid na ka jait Juda shathie eh haduh khap-pud Edom ki dei ka Kabzeel, ka Eder, ka Jakur,
ka Kina, ka Dimona, ka Adada,
ka Kedesh, ka Hazor, ka Ithnan,
ka Ziph, ka Telem, ka Bealoth,
ka Hazor-hadatta, ka Kerioth-hesron (kata ka mut, ka Hazor),
ka Amam, ka Shema, ka Molada,
ka Hazar-Gadda, ka Heshmon, ka Beth-pelet,
ka Hazar-shual, ka Beer-sheba, ka Bisiothia,
ka Baala, ka Iim, ka Ezem,
ka Eltolad, ka Khesil, ka Horma,
ka Ziklag, ka Madmanna, ka Sansanna,
ka Lebaoth, ka Shilhim, ka Ain, bad ka Rimmon: ki don baroh arphew khyndai tylli ki nongbah, lem bad ki nongrit jong ki.
Ha ri them pat, ka Eshtaol, ka Zora, ka Ashna,
ka Zanoa, ka Enkannim, ka Tappua, ka Enam,
ka Jarmuth, ka Adullam, ka Soko, ka Aseka,
ka Sha-ara-im, ka Adithaim, ka Gedera, ka Gederothaim: khatsaw tylli ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki.
Ka Genan, ka Hadasha, ka Migdalkad,
ka Dillan, ka Mizpe, ka Jokthe-el,
ka Lakhish, ka Bozkath, ka Eglon,
ka Kabbon, ka Lahmam, ka Khitlish,
ka Gederoth, ka Beth-dakon, ka Naama bad ka Makkeda: khathynriew tylli ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki.
Ka Libna, ka Ether, ka Ashan,
ka Iphta, ka Ashna, ka Nesib,
ka Keila, ka Akhsib bad ka Maresha: ki don khyndai tylli ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki.
Ka Ekron lem bad ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ka;
naduh Ekron haduh duriaw, baroh ki shnong kiba harud Ashdod bad ki nongrit jong ki.
Ka Ashdod, ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ka; ka Gaza, ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ka; haduh ka wah duid Ijipt bad ka Duriaw Bakhraw lem bad ka rud duriaw jong ka.
Sa ha ri lum, ka Shamir, ka Jattir, ka Soko,
ka Danna, ka Kiriath-sanna (kata ka mut, ka Debir),
ka Anab, ka Eshtomoh, ka Anim,
ka Goshen, ka Holon, bad ka Gilo: khatwei tylli ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki.
Ka Arab, ka Duma, ka Eshan,
ka Janim, ka Beth-tappua, ka Apheka,
ka Humta, ka Kiriath-arba (kata ka mut, ka Hebron), bad ka Zior: ki don khyndai tylli ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki.
Ka Maon, ka Karmel, ka Ziph, ka Jutta,
ka Jezreel, ka Jokdeam, ka Zanoa,
ka Kain, ka Gibea, bad ka Timna: shiphew tylli ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki.
Ka Halhul, ka Beth-Zur, ka Gedor,
ka Maarath, ka Beth-anoth, bad ka Eltekon: ki don hynriew tylli ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki.
Ka Kiriath-baal (kata ka mut, ka Kiriath-Jearim) bad ka Rabba: ar tylli ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki.
Ha ri kynjah, ka don ka Beth-Araba, ka Middin, ka Sekaka,
ka Nibshan, ka Nongbah Mluh, bad ka En-Gedi: hynriew tylli ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki.
Hynrei ki paid Juda kim shym lah ban pynmih noh ïa ki Jebus, ki trai shnong ka Jerusalem. Kumta ki Jebus ki dang ïa im lang sah lang bad ki paid Juda ha Jerusalem haduh kane ka sngi.
Ka bynta ba ïoh ki nonghiar pateng u Joseph ka la leit na ka Jordan ha Jerikho sha ki um Jerikho, sha mihngi ka ri shyiap: nangta ka pud ka la kiew na Jerikho sha ri lum haduh Bethel.
Na Bethel ka leit sha Lus, nangta haduh Ataroth, ka ri ki Arkhis;
nangta ka phai shaphang sepngi shaduh ka ri ki Japhlet, haduh khap-pud ka Beth-horon Basha-rum, sa nangta pat sha Gezer, bad ka kut ha duriaw.
Ki paid jong u Joseph, u Manasse bad u Ephraim ki la ïoh la ka bynta bynta.
Ka ri jong ki khun u Ephraim katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ki ka la long kumne harum: na mihngi u pud jong ka bynta jong ki u sdang na Ataroth-addar ter ter shaduh Beth-horon Basha-neng,
nangta u pud u ïaid sha duriaw; shaphang shatei ka don ka Mikhme-thath; nangta na mihngi u pud u khun shaphang Taanath-shilo, u ïaid shakhmat shuh shuh naphang mihngi haduh Janoa.
Na Janoa u noh arsut sha Ataroth sha Naara haduh ban da poi Jerikho bad u kut ha Jordan.
Na Tappua, u pud u phai sha sepngi haduh wahduid Kana, bad u kut ha duriaw. Kane ka long ka bynta jong ki paid na ka jait Ephraim katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ki,
lem bad ki nongbah ba la mang kyrpang na ka bynta ki paid Ephraim hapoh ka nongkynti jong ki paid Manasse, baroh kito ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki.
Pynban kim shym beh noh ïa ki nong Kanaan kiba la shong ha Gezer. Kumta ki nong Kanaan ki dang shong hapdeng ki Ephraim haduh kane ka sngi, hynrei ki la kylla mraw ban trei kam khalasi.

Nangta la ai bynta ïa ka jait Manasse, namar u la long u khun nyngkong jong u Joseph. Ha u Makhir u khun phrangsngi jong u Manasse, u kpa u Gilead, la ai bynta ka Gilead bad ka Bashan, namar u la long u ’riewthma.

La ai bynta ïa kiwei pat ki khun na ka jait Manasse katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ki, ïa u Abieser, u Helek, u Asriel, u Shekhem, u Hepher bad u Shemida. Kine ki la long ki khun shynrang u Manasse, u khun u Joseph, katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ki.

U Zelophehad u khun u Hepher, u khun u Gilead, u khun u Makhir, u khun u Manasse um don khun shynrang, hynrei tang ki khun kynthei. Kine ki kyrteng jong ki khun kynthei jong u: ka Mahla, ka Noa, ka Hokla, ka Milka bad ka Tirza.

Kine ki la wan hakhmat u Eleasar lyngdoh bad u Joshwa khun u Nun bad ki tymmen ki san, ki da ong, “U Trai U la hukum ïa u Moses ban ai bynta lem ïa ngi bad ki hynmen ki para jong ngi”. Kumta katkum ka hukum u Trai u la ai bynta ïa ki hapdeng ki hynmen ki para u kpa jong ki.
Kumta la hap ha u Manasse shiphew bynta nalor ka ri Gilead bad ka Bashan kaba sha shiliang ka Jordan,
namar ki khun kynthei jong u Manasse ki la ïoh bynta lang bad ki khun shynrang jong u. Ïa ka ri Gilead la ai bynta ha kiwei pat ki khun u Manasse.
Ka ri jong u Manasse ka ïar naduh Asher haduh Mikhmethath sha mihngi ka Shekhem. Nangta u pud u noh shaphang shathie shaduh markhap bad ki nong En-tappua.
Ka ri Tappua ka dei ka jong u Manasse, hynrei ka nongbah Tappua ha ka pud u Manasse ka dei jong ki khun shynrang u Ephraim.

Nangta u pud u hiar arsut shaduh wahduid Kana. Ki nongbah kiba shathie ka wahduid hapdeng ki nongbah u Manasse, ki dei ki jong u Ephraim. Nangta pat u pud jong u Manasse u leit shaphang shatei jong ka wahduid bad u kut ha duriaw.
Ka ri kaba shaphang shathie ka dei ka jong u Ephraim, kaba shatei pat ka jong u Manasse; ki pynlong pud da ka duriaw. Na shatei poi ha Asher bad na mihngi ha Issakhar.

Ha Issakhar bad ha Asher ruh u Manasse u don ka Beth-shean bad ki nongrit jong ka, ka Ibleam bad ki nongrit jong ka, ki trai shnong jong ka Dor bad ki nongrit jong ka, ki trai shnong ka En-dor bad ki nongrit jong ka, ki trai shnong ka Taanak bad ki nongrit jong ka, ki trai shnong ka Megiddo bad ki nongrit jong ka, bad sa shi bynta na ki lai bynta ka Naphath.
Pynban ki khun u Manasse kim lah satia ban dakhol ïa kitei ki nongbah, namar ki nong Kanaan ki la shong la ka shong ha kata ka ri.
Hynrei ynda ki paid Israel ki la sngewkhlaiñ, ki la pyntrei kam khalasi ïa ki, khlem da lah pynmih noh ïa ki.
Te ki jait Joseph ki la ong ha u Joshwa, “Balei phi ai ïa ngi tang shi bhah, tang shi bynta kum ka nongkynti haba ngi long u paid u babun bad u Trai U la kyrkhu kyrdoh ïa ngi?”
U Joshwa pat u la jubab ïa ki. “Lada phi bun paid khie leit sha ka khlaw, bad pynkhuid jaka ïa lade ha ka ri jong ki Peris bad ki Rephaim, namar ka ri lum u Ephraim ka khim eh ïa phi.”

Ki jait Joseph pat ki la phai ktien, “Ka ri lum kam biang ïa ngi; nangta pat ki nong Kanaan kiba shong ha ri thor ki don ki kali nar, khamtam kito kiba ha Beth-shean bad ki nongrit jong ka, bad kito kiba ha ka Them Jezreel.”
Te u Joshwa u la ong ha ki kur ki jait u Joseph, u Ephraim bad u Manasse, “Phi long ki babun paid bad phi don shibun ka bor. Phin ym ïoh tang shi bynta;

ka ri lum kan long ka jong phi, namar lada ka dei ka khlaw ruh, phin sa pynkhuid ïa ka bad phin sa buhai ïa ka haduh bakut ki pud jong ka. Phin sa beh krad ïa ki nong Kanaan wat la ki don ki kali nar bad ki khlaiñ bor.”
Te ki paidbah Israel baroh ki la ïalum lang ha Shilo bad ki la shna ka dara jingïakynduh hangta. Ïa ka ri baroh ki la lah pyndem.
Hapdeng ki paid Israel don sa hynñiew ki jait ki bym pat ïoh bynta.
Kumta u Joshwa u la ong ha ki paid Israel, “Balei sha phi leh suki ban leit dakhol ïa ka ri kaba u Trai u Blei jong ki kpa jong phi U la ai ïa phi?
Pynmih lai ngut ki briew na kawei kawei ka jait ba kin leit jurib ïa ka ri, kin thoh jingbatai kaba ïadei bad ka rukom sam bynta, nangta kin sa wan ïathuh ha nga.
Kin phiah ïa ka hynñiew nuid, u Juda un sah ha la ka khyndew ka bashathie, bad ki kur ki jait u Joseph ha la ka khyndew ka bashatei.
Phin pynbynta ïa ka ri ha ki hynñiew bynta, nangta wan rah ïa kata ka jingbatai shane sha nga. Ngan pynïakhalai nusip na ka bynta jong phi hangne hakhmat u Trai u Blei jong ngi.

Kiba na ka jait Lebi kim don bynta hapdeng jong phi, namar ka jinglong lyngdoh jong u Trai ka long ka nongkynti jong ki. Ki jait Gad, jait Reuben bad ka shiteng ka jait Manasse ki la lah ïoh la ka bynta sha shiliang ka Jordan shaphang mihngi, kumba la ai ïa ki da u Moses, u shakri u Trai.”

Kumta kita ki briew ki la mih ban leit, bad u Joshwa u la hukum ïa ki ban thoh jingbatai shaphang ka ri, u da ong, “To leit jurib bad to thoh ka jingbatai ïa ka ri, nangta sa wan sha nga ba ngan pynkhalai nusip hangne na ka bynta jong phi hakhmat u Trai ha Shilo.”
Kumta kita ki briew ki la leit jurib ïa ka ri bad ki la thoh jingbatai ïa ka ha ka kot ha ki hynñiew bynta katkum ki nongbah. Nangta ki la wan sha u Joshwa ha ka ïing dara ha Shilo,
bad u Joshwa u la pynkhalai nusip na ka bynta jong ki ha Shilo hakhmat u Trai, nangta u la phiah ïa ka ri hapdeng ki paid Israel, uwei pa uwei la ka bynta bynta.
La mih ka bynta ïa ka jait Benjamin bad ki ïing ki sem jong ka, bad ka ri ba hap ha ka ka dei hapdeng ka jait Juda bad ka jait Joseph.
Na shatei u pud jong ki u sdang na Jordan bad u leit sha ka tyrpeng kaba shatei ka Jerikho, nangta lyngba ka ri lum shaphang sepngi bad ka kut ha ka ri kynjah Beth-aben.
Nangta u pud u suh arsut shaphang shathie sha Lus, sha ka sharing jong ka Lus (kata, ka Bethel), nangta u hiar haduh Ataroth-addar, halor u lum uba don shaphang shathie ka Beth-horon Basha-rum.

Nangta u pud u phai sa shawei pat, u khun sha ka dong sepngi arsut na u lum uba don shaphang shathie, mar pyrshah ka Beth-horon, u kut artat ha Kiriath-baal (kata ka mut, ka Kiriath-Jearim), ka nongbah jong ka jait Juda. Kane ka long na ka dong sepngi.
Ka dong bashathie ka sdang narud ka Kiriath-Jearim, ka suh nangta sha Ephron, shaduh ka tlong jong ki Um Neptoa.

Nangta u pud u noh arsut sha khap u lum uba ïeng halor ka them u khun u Hinnom, kaba don ha bakut shatei jong ka them Rephaim. Nangta pat ka noh ïa ka them Hinnom shathie jong ka sharing ki Jebus arsut arsut shaduh Enrogel.
Nangta ka khun artet sha Enshemesh, nangta sa sha Keliloth kaba pyrshah u thiep Adummim. Nangne ka hiar arsut shaduh u Maw u Bohan, u khun u Reuben.
Ynda phai shaphang shatei jong ka sharing ka Beth-araba ka hiar pat sha Araba.
Nangne u pud u kiew shatei jong ka sharing ka Beth-hogla, bad u kut ha ka kyndong um kaba shatei jong ka Duriaw Mluh, ha ka tduh kaba shathie jong ka Jordan. Kane ka long ka pud ba shaphang shathie.
Na ka dong mihngi, ka Jordan ka dei u pud jong ka. Kane ka long ka nongkynti jong ka jait Benjamin, katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ka, la ki pud ki bathikna.
Ki nongbah jong ka jait Benjamin katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ki dei ka Jerikho, ka Beth-hogla, ka Emekkesis,
ka Beth-araba, ka Zemaraim, ka Bethel,
ka Abbim, ka Para, ka Ophra,
ka Khepharammoni, ka Ophni, ka Geba—khat-ar tylli ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki;
ka Gibeon, ka Rama, ka Beeroth,
ka Mizpe, ka Khephira, ka Mosa,
ka Rekem, ka Irpeel, ka Tarala,

ka Zela, ka Ha-elep, ka Jebus (kata ka mut, ka Jerusalem), ka Gibea bad ka Kiriath-Jearim—khatsaw tylli ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki. Kane ka long ka nongkynti jong ka jait Benjamin katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ki.
Ha ka jingkhalai ka ba-ar la mih ka jait Simeon, katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ka, bad ka nongkynti jong ka ka hap hapdeng ka bynta jong ka jait Juda.
Ka la ïoh bynta ka Beersheba, ka Sheba, ka Molada,
ka Hasar-shual, ka Bala, ka Esem,
ka Eltolad, ka Bethul, ka Horma,
ka Ziklag, ka Beth-mar-kaboth, ka Hasar-susa,
ka Beth-lebaoth, bad ka Sharuhen—khat-lai tylli ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki.
Ka En-rimmon, ka Ether, bad ka Ashan—saw tylli ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki,
bad ki nongrit baroh kiba sawdong kine ki nongbah haduh Baalath-beer, ka Rama jong ka Nekeb. Kane ka dei ka nongkynti jong ka jait Simeon katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ka.
Ka ri kynti jong ka jait Simeon ka dei bynta hapoh ka ri Juda; namar ka bynta jong ki jait Juda ka heh than ïa ki, ka jait Simeon ka la ïoh bynta hapdeng ka ri kynti jong ki.
Ha ka jingkhalai ka balai la mih ka jait Zebulun katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ka. Ka ri jong ka ka poi haduh Sarid.
Nangne u pud jong ka u leit shaphang sepsngi, ter ter haduh Markal, bad u kynduh ïa ka Dabbesheth, nangta ïa ka wahduid sha mihngi ka Jokne-am;
na Sarid u phai shaphang mihngi shaduh khap Khisloth-tabor, nangta sha Daberath haduh Japhia.
Nangne u leit sha mihngi haduh Gath-hepher bad Eth-ka-sin, bad ynda poi ha Rimmon, u khun shaphang Nea.
Na shaphang shatei, u pud u khun shaphang Hannathon bad u kut ha ka them Iphtahel.
La don sa ka Kattath, ka Nahalal, ka Shimron, ka Idala bad ka Bethlehem—don khat-ar tylli ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki.
Kane ka long ka nongkynti jong ka jait Zebulun, katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ka—kine ki long ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki.
La mih u Issakhar, ka jait Issakhar, ha ka jingkhalai ka basaw, bad ki ïing ki sem jong ka.
Ka ri jong ka ka kynthup ïa ka Jezreel, ka Khesulloth, ka Shunem,
ka Hapharaim, ka Shion, ka Anaharath,
ka Rabbith, ka Kishion, ka Ebes,
ka Remeth, ka En-kannim, ka En-hadda, ka Beth-passes;
u pud jong ka u poi haduh Tabor, Shahasuma, bad Beth-shemesh, bad u kut ha Jordan—don khathynriew tylli ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki.
Kane ka long ka nongkynti jong ka jait Issakhar, katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ka—kine ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki.
Ha ka jingkhalai ka basan la mih ka jait Asher katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ka.
Ka ri jong ka ka kynthup ïa ka Helkath, ka Hali, ka Beten, ka Akhshaph,
ka Allammelekh, ka Amad bad ka Mishal. Na sepngi ka poi sha Karmel bad Shihorlibnath,
nangta ka phai sha mihngi bad ka leit haduh Beth-dagon ka ïakynduh ïa ka Zebulun bad ka them Iphtahel shaphang shatei haduh Beth-emek bad Neiel. Nangne ka leit shatei haduh Kabul;
sha Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, Kana, haduh ka Sidon Bakhraw.
Nangne u pud u khun sha Rama, bad u poi haduh Tirus, ka nongbah baker kynroh. Sa nangne u pud u khun sha Hosa bad u kut artat ha duriaw. Don sa ka Mahalab, ka Akhsib,
ka Umma, ka Aphek bad ka Rehob—don arphew ar tylli ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki.
Kane ka long ka nongkynti jong ka jait Asher katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ki—kine ki dei ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki.
La mih ka jait Naphtali ha ka jingkhalai ka bahynriew na ka bynta ka jait Naphtali katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ka.
U pud jong ka u sdang na Heleph bad ka dieng bti ha Zanaannim ter ter haduh Adaminekeb, Jabneel bad Lakkum. U kut ha Jordan.
Nangta u pud u khun sha sepngi sha Asnoth-tabor, nangta sha Hukkok, u kynduh ïa ka Zebulun shaphang shathie, ïa ka Asher shaphang sepngi bad ïa ka Juda shaphang mihngi ha Jordan.
Ki nongbah ba ker kynroh ki dei ka Ziddim, ka Zer, ka Hammath, ka Rakkath, ka Khinnereth,
ka Adama, ka Rama, ka Hazor,
ka Kedesh, ka Edrei, ka Enhazor,
ka Jiron, ka Mikdal-el, ka Horem, ka Beth-anath, bad ka Beth-shemesh—khatkhyndai tylli ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki.
Kane ka nongkynti jong ka jait Naphtali katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ki—kine ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki.
Ha ka jingkhalai ka bahynñiew la mih ka jait Dan, katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ka.
Ka ri kynti jong ka ka kynthup ïa ka Zora, ka Eshta-ol, ka Irshemesh,
ka Sha-alabbin, ka Aijalon, ka Ithla,
ka Elon, ka Timna, ka Ekron,
ka Eltekke, ka Gibbethon, ka Baalath,
ka Jehud, ka Bene-berak, ka Gath-Rimmon,
ka Me-jarkon bad ka Rakkon lem bad ka ri kaba ha pyrshah Joppa.

Haba ki khun u Dan ki la duh ïa ka ri jong ki, ki la leit kiew bad ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka Leshem. Ynda ki la ïoh knieh ïa ka da ka waitlam, ki la buhai ïa ka bad ki la shong la sah ha ka, ki da pynkylla noh ïa ka kyrteng Leshem sha Dan, ka kyrteng u kpa tymmen jong ki, u Dan.
Kane ka long ka nongkynti jong ka jait Dan, katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ki—kine ki long ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki.
Ynda ki la dep sam ïa ki khyndew baroh jong ka ri kum ki nongkynti, ki paid Israel ki la ai ka nongkynti ïa u Joshwa, u khun u Nun, hapdeng jong ki.
Da ka hukum jong u Trai ki la ai ïa u ka nongbah ba u la pan, ka Timnath-sera ha kyndiang ka ri lum Ephraim, bad u la tei biang ïa ka nongbah bad u la shong ha ka.

Kine ki long ki nongkynti, kiba u Eleasar lyngdoh, u Joshwa u khun u Nun, bad ki rangbah jong ki ïing ki sem u paidbah Israel ki la ïasam da kaba khalai nusip ha Shilo hakhmat u Trai ha ka jynkhang jong ka dara jingïakynduh. Kumta la dep ka jingïasam bynta ïa ka ri.
Te u Trai U la ong ha u Joshwa,
“To kren ha ki paid Israel kumne: To buh ïa ki shnong jaka rieh ïa kiba Nga la kren ha phi da u Moses,
ba u nongpynïap briew uba kum pynïap ïa uno uno u briew khlem da mut, ne khlem leh khnang, u lah ban phet rieh hangta. Kin long ka jaka rieh jong phi na u nongpynïap kylliang ha ka hok.

Un phet sha kano kano na kine ki nongbah, un ïeng hakhmat khyrdop jong ka shnong bad un batai ïa ka jingjia ha ki tymmen ki san jong kata ka shnong. Nangta kin pynrung ïa u hapoh shnong, kin ai jaka ïa u, bad un sah bad ki.

Lada u nongpynhiar kput snam u beh nadien jong u, kim dei ban aiti ïa u nongpynïap ha ka kti jong u, namarba u la kum pynïap ïa la u para marjan khlem da pyrkhat, khlem da don jingïashun bad u mynshuwa.

Une un sah ha kata ka nongbah haduh ba ynda bishar ïa u hakhmat u paid ba ïalang, haduh ka jingïap jong u lyngdoh rangbah uba ha kata ka por. Hadien nangta u nongpynïap u lah ban leit phai sha la ka shnong bad ka ïing lajong, sha ka shnong na kaba u la phet.”
Kumta ki la buh kyrpang ïa ka Kedesh ha Galilea ha ri lum Naphtali, ïa ka Shekhem ha ri lum Ephraim, bad ïa ka Kiriath-arba (kata ka mut, ka Hebron) ha ri lum Juda.

Sha lyndet ka Jordan mihngi na Jerikho, ki la buh ïa ka Bezer ha ka ri kynjah kaba ha kynjang lum, na ka jait u Reuben, ha Ramoth kaba ha Gilead, na ka jait Gad, bad ha Golan kaba ha Bashan, na ka jait Manasse.

Kine ki la long ki shnong ba la mang na ka bynta u paid Israel baroh, bad na ka bynta u ’riewsoh shnong uba wan sah bad ki, khnang ba uno uno uba kum pynïap briew khlem da mut, u lah ban wan phet rieh hangta, ba yn ym shah pynïap ha ka kti u nongpynhiar kput snam haduh ba yn da bishar da u paid ba ïalang.
Te ki rangbah jong ki ïing ki sem u Lebi ki la wan sha u Eleasar lyngdoh, sha u Joshwa u khun u Nun, bad sha ki rangbah jong ki ïing ki sem ki paid Israel.
Ki la ong ha ki ha Shilo ha ri Kanaan, “U Trai U la hukum da u Moses ba ïa ngi ruh yn ai ki shnong ba ngin shong lem bad ki jaka bamphlang na ka bynta ki jynri.”
Kumta da ka hukum u Trai ki paid Israel ki la ai ïa ki jait Lebi kine harum ki shnong bad ki jaka bamphlang na ki bhah jong ki.

Da ka jingkhalai nusip la mih ki kur u Kohath. Kumta da kaba khalai nusip kito ki jait Lebi kiba hiar pateng na u Aron lyngdoh ki la ïoh khat-lai shnong na ki raid u Juda, raid u Simeon bad u Benjamin.
Kiwei pat ki kur u Kohath, da kaba khalai nusip, ki la ïoh na ki kur u Ephraim, bad ki kur u Dan bad shiteng ka raid u Manasse.
Da kaba khalai nusip, ki kur u Gershon ki la ïoh khat-lai shnong na ka raid ki kur u Issakhar, u Asher, u Naphtali bad shiteng ka raid ki kur u Manasse kaba ha Bashan, khat-lai shnong.
Ki kur u Merar, katkum ki ïing ki sem jong ki ki la ïoh khat-ar tylli ki shnong, na ki raid u Reuben, u Gad bad u Zebulun.
Ïa kine ki shnong bad ki jaka bamphlang la ai da kaba shu khalai nusip ha ki Raid Lebi da ki paid Israel, kumba u Trai U la lah hukum da u Moses.
