Na ka Raid Juda bad ka jait Simeon ki la ai ïa kine ki shnong ba ai kyrteng harum.
Kiba la ïoh dei ki khun ki ksiew u Aron, ki kur jong u Kohath na ka jait Lebi, namar ha kaba khalai nusip la pom nyngkong ma ki.
Ki la ai ïa ki ka Kiriath-arba (u Arba u dei u kpa u Anak) kata ka mut ka Hebron, ha ri lum Juda, lem bad ki jaka bamphlang sawdong jong ka.
Hynrei ïa ki lyngkha bad ki nongrit jong ka la lah ai ha u Kaleb, u khun u Jephunne, kum ka ri kynti jong u.
Ha ki khun ki ksiew u Aron lyngdoh ki la ai ka Hebron ka shnong jaka rieh u nongpynïap briew, lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka, nangta ka Libna lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka,
nangta ka Jattir lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka, ka Eshtemoa lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka,
nangta ka Holon lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka, ka Debir lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka,
nangta ka Ain lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka, ka Jutta lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka, ka Beth-shemesh lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka—khyndai tylli ki shnong na kine ki ar Raid.
Na ka Raid Benjamin, saw tylli: ka Gibeon lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka, ka Geba lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka,
nangta ka Anathoth lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka, bad ka Almon lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka.
Ki shnong ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Aron, ki lyngdoh, ki la long khat-lai tylli lem bad ki jaka bamphlang.
Ïa kiwei pat ki ïing ki sem na ka jait Lebi kiba ïadei kur bad u Kohath la ai bynta da ki shnong kiba na ka Raid u Ephraim.
Ha ki la ai saw tylli ki shnong ka Shekhem, ka shnong jaka rieh u nongpynïap briew, lem bad ki jaka bamphlang ha ri lum Ephraim, ka Gezer lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka,
nangta ka Kibsaim lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka, bad Beth-horon lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka.
Nangta la ai saw tylli ki shnong na ka Raid Dan, ka Elteke lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka, ka Gibbethon lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka,
nangta ka Aijalon lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka, bad ka Gath-rimmon lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka.
Na shiteng ka Raid Manasse, la ai ar tylli ki shnong ka Taanak lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka, bad ka Gath-rimmon lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka.
Ki shnong jong kiwei pat ki ïingkur u Kohath ki la long baroh shiphew tylli, lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ki.

Ïa ki ïingkur u Gershon na ka jait Lebi la ai ar tylli ki shnong na shiteng ka Raid Manasse, ka Golan ha Bashan, ka shnong jaka rieh u nongpynïap briew, lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka, bad ka Beeshtera lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka.
Na ka Raid Issakhar, saw tylli ki shnong ka Kishion lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka, ka Daberath lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka,
nangta ka Jarmuth lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka, ka En-Gannim lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka.
Na ka Raid Asher, saw tylli ki shnong ka Mishal lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka, ka Abdon lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka,
nangta ka Helkath lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka, bad ka Rehob lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka.

Na ka Raid Naphtali, ka Kedesh kaba ha Galilea lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka, ka shnong jaka rieh u nongpynïap briew, ka Hammoth-dor lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka, bad ka Kartan lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka.
Baroh ki shnong bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ki ïing kur u Gershon ki long khat-lai tylli.
Ïa kiwei pat ki jait Lebi, ki ïingkur u Merar, la ai bynta na ka jait Zebulun, ka Jokne-am lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka, ka Karta lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka,
nangta ka Dimna lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka, bad ka Nahalal lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka.
Na ka Raid Reuben, la ai saw tylli ki shnong ka Bezer lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka, ka Jahas lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka,
ka Kedemoth lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka, bad ka Mepha-ath lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka.
Na ka Raid u Gad, ka Ramoth ha Gilead lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka, ka shnong jaka rieh u nongpynïap briew, ka Mahanaim lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka,
nangta ka Heshbon lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka, bad ka Jazer lem bad ki jaka bamphlang jong ka.
Ki shnong ba la ai bynta ïa ki ïing kur u Merar, ki bakhatduh na ka jait Lebi, ki long baroh khat-ar tylli.
Ki shnong ki Lebi hapdeng ki khyndew jong ki paid Israel ki la long sawphew phra tylli baroh lem bad ki jaka bamphlang.
Kawei pa kawei ka shnong ka don la ka jaka bamphlang ha rudnong; ka la long kumne ïa ki shnong baroh.
Te kumta u Trai U la ai ha ki Israel ïa ka ri baroh ba U la kular ban ai ha ki kpa jong ki, bad ynda ki la buhai ïa ka, ki la shong duh de hangta.

Bad u Trai U la ai jingsuk jingsaiñ ïa ki na baroh sawdong thik kumba U la kular ha ki kpa jong ki. Ym shym don wat uwei na ki nongshun jong ki uba la lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ki, naba u Trai U la aiti ïa ki nongshun jong ki baroh ha ki kti jong ki.
Ym shym don wat kawei na ki jingkular ba u Trai U la ai ïa ka ïing u Israel kaba la pulom. Baroh lin ki la urlong.
U Joshwa u la khot lang ïa ka jait Reuben, ka jait Gad, bad ïa ka shiteng ka jait Manasse,
bad u la kren kumne ha ki, “Phi la rakhe baroh kaba u Moses, u shakri u Trai, u la hukum ïa phi, bad phi la kohnguh ïa ka ktien jong nga katba nga la hukum ïa phi;
phim shym la ieh noh ïa la ki para ha kine ki sngi baroh, haduh kane ka sngi, bad phi la phikir bha ban sumar ïa kata kaba u Trai u Blei jong phi U la pynkhamti ha phi.

Te mynta u Trai u Blei jong phi U la ai jingshongthait ïa ki para jong phi, kumba U la kular ïa ki, bad phi to khie leit phai sha la ïing la sem ha ka ri ba phi ïoh kynti, ïa kaba u Moses, u shakri u Trai, u la ai ïa phi sha lyndet ka Jordan.

To sumar bha ban rakhe ïa ka hukum bad ka aiñ kaba u Moses, u shakri u Trai, u la hukum ïa phi, ban ieid ïa u Trai u Blei jong phi, ban ïaid ha ki lynti jong U baroh, ban sumar ïa ki hukum jong U, ban snoh ha U, bad ban shakri ïa U da ka dohnud bad ka mynsiem jong phi baroh.”
Kumta u Joshwa u la kyrkhu kyrdoh ïa ki bad u la phah noh ïa ki. Te ki la leit phai sha la ki ïing.

Ïa ka shiteng ka jait Manasse u Moses u la ai ri kynti ha Bashan, hynrei ïa kawei pat ka shiteng u Joshwa u la ai jaka buhai markhap ki para jong ki ha ka ri sha sepngi ka Jordan. Haba u Joshwa u la phah noh ïa ki sha la ki ïing, u la kyrkhu ïa ki.

U la ong ha ki, “Khie leit phai sha la ki ïing bad ka spah ka hajar byllien, bad ki jynri jyndup bad ka rupa, ka ksiar, ka rnong, u nar bad ki jaiñ ki nep. To ïasam lang baroh shipara ïa ka bai kliarwait na ki nongshun jong phi.”

Kumta ki jait ki kynja u Reuben, u Gad, bad ka shiteng ka jait Manasse ki la leit phai sha la ïing. Ki la khlad na ki paid Israel kiba ha Shilo, ka shnong ha ri Kanaan, bad ki la leit sha ka ri Gilead, ka ri ba ki la buhai katkum ka hukum u Trai ba la ai da u Moses.
Te ynda ki la poi sha ki thaiñ ka Jordan, hapoh khyndew ri Kanaan, ka jait Reuben, ka jait Gad bad ka shiteng ka jait Manasse ki la tei hangta ka duwan kaba heh shibun ha khap ka Jordan.

Ki paid Israel ki la ïoh khubor ba ka jait Reuben, ka jait Gad bad ka shiteng ka jait Manasse ki la tei ka duwan ha khap-pud ka ri Kanaan, ha ki thaiñ ka Jordan, ha ka liang ba dei ka jong ki paid Israel.
Haba ki paidbah Israel ki la ïohsngew ïa kane, ki la lum dorbar lang ha Shilo baroh shi paid Israel ban leit ïaleh thma ïa ki.
Kumta ki paid Israel ki la phah ïa u Phinehas, u khun u Eleasar lyngdoh sha ki jait Reuben, ki jait Gad bad ka shiteng ka jait Manasse, ha ri Gilead.
Ki la leit bad u shiphew ngut ki ’riewrangbah, uwei uwei u rangbah na kawei kawei ka ïingkur jong ki jait Israel; uwei pa uwei na ki u la long u khlieh ka ïing ka sem kur lajong kaba ha Israel.
Te ki la wan sha ka jait Reuben, ka jait Gad bad ka shiteng ka jait Manasse, ha ri Gilead, bad ki la ong kumne ha ki,

“U paidbah baroh jong u Trai u ong kumne, ‘Balei sha phi shet kylla kumne pyrshah ïa u Blei ka Israel, bad phi ieh noh noh ha kane ka sngi ban bud ïa u Trai, da kaba tei ïa lade ka duwan kum ka kam ïaleh pyrshah ïa u Trai?
Hato ym pat biang mo seh ka pap ha Peor na kaba ngim pat lah ban pynkhuid ïa lade haduh mynta, bad na ka bynta jong ka ka la wan ka khlam halor u paid u Trai,
ba sa ma phi pat mynta ka sngi phin kylla dien ban ym bud shuh ïa u Trai? Lada phi ïeng pyrshah ïa u Trai mynta ka sngi, lashai Un sa bitar ïa u paid Israel baroh.

Te mynta, lada phi kheiñ ka ri jong phi ka bymkhuid, ïa noh shatai sha ka ri u Trai ha kaba don ka ïing bakhuid jong U, bad to shong to sah noh bad ngi. Tang ba wat ïaleh pyrshah keiñ ïa u Trai; ne ïa ngi ruh wat pynlong kum ki nongïaleh pyrshah, da kaba tei kawei ka duwan ïa lade nalor ka duwan jong u Trai u Blei jong ngi.

Hato ym dei u Akhan, u khun u Zera, mo uba la pynkheiñ ïa la ka jingngeit ha kiei kiei kiba la mana bad kumta ka jingbitar ka la hiar halor u paid Israel baroh? Um shym ïap tang ma u marwei na ka bynta ka kam bymman jong u!’ ”
Hangta ki jait Reuben, ki jait Gad bad ka shiteng ka jait Manasse ki la ai jubab ïa ki rangbah jong ki ïingkur ka Israel,
“U Badonbor, u Blei, u Trai! U Badonbor, u Blei, u Trai U tip; ka Israel ruh to kan tip! Lada ka dei ka jingleh pyrshah, ne ka jingpynkheiñ ïa ka jingngeit ha u Trai, wat pynsah ïa ngi mynta ka sngi.

Lada ngi la tei ka duwan ban ieh noh noh ïa u Trai, lada ngi la leh kumta ban tyrwa ki jynkñia thang, ne ki jynkñia jynbam, ne ki jynkñia ïabha ïamiat halor jong ka, ai ba u Trai hi Un pynsaja ïa ngi.
Ym dei kumta. Ngi la leh ïa kane da ka jingtieng, ïoh ba hadien habud ki khun jong phi kin ong ha ki khun jong ngi, ‘Phi don kam aïu ma phi bad u Trai, u Blei ka Israel?

Namar u Trai U la pynlong pud ïa ka Jordan hapdeng jong ngi bad phi ki Raid Reuben bad ki jait Gad, kumta phim don bynta ei ei ha u Trai.’ Kumta ki khun jong phi kin pynsangeh ïa ki khun jong ngi ban mane ïa u Trai.
Namarkata ngi la ïa-ong. To ngin ïatei mynta ka duwan, ym na ka bynta ki jynkñia thang ne kiwei pat ki jynkñia,

hynrei kum ka sakhi hapdeng jong ngi bad jong phi, bad ha ki pateng bynriew kiba hadien jong ngi, ba ngi mane ïa u Trai da ki jingtyrwa thang, ki jynkñia bad ki jyntyrwa ïabha ïamiat hakhmat u Trai; ïoh ki khun jong phi ki ong ha ki khun jong ngi hadien habud, ‘Phim don bynta satia ha u Trai.’

Te ngi la pyrkhat ba lada kumno re kumno yn kum kynnoh ïa ngi ne ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong ngi hadien habud, ngin da ong, ‘Ha peit kane ka nuksa jong ka duwan u Trai kaba ki kpa jong ngi ki la thaw, ym na ka bynta ki jyntyrwa thang, ne kano kano ka jynkñia, hynrei ban long ka sakhi hapdeng jong ngi bad phi.’

Da lei lei ruh em ngin ym ïeng pyrshah ïa u Trai, ne ngin ym ieh noh ïa U da kaba tei ka duwan ban tyrwa jynkñia thang, ne jynkñia bam ne kano kano ka jynkñia, nalor ka duwan u Trai u Blei jong ngi kaba ïeng hakhmat ka ïing bakhuid jong U!”
Haba u Phinehas lyngdoh, ki rangbah u paid, bad ki khlieh jong ki ïing ki sem ka Israel kiba ïadon bad u ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingbatai ki Reuben, ki Gad bad ki Manasse, ki la sngewbha shibun.

Te u Phinehas, u khun u Eleasar lyngdoh u la ong ha ki jait Reuben, ki jait Gad bad ki jait Manasse, “Mynta ka sngi ngi tip ba u Trai U don hapdeng jong ngi, namarba phim shym la shet kylla pyrshah ïa u Trai. Mynta phi la pyllait im ïa u paid Israel na ka kti u Trai.”

Hadien kata u Phinehas, u khun u Eleasar lyngdoh, bad ki rangbah, ki la wan phai na ki jait Reuben, bad ki jait Gad kiba ha ri Gilead sha ri Kanaan, sha u paid Israel bad ki la wan rah ïa katei ka khubor ha ki.
Te ki Israel ki la sngewbha ïa ka jingïathuh. Ki paid Israel ki la ainguh ïa u Trai bad kim ïakren shuh shaphang ka jinghiar thma ïa ki, ka jingpynjot ïa ka ri ki jait Reuben bad ki jait Gad.
Ki jait Reuben bad ki jait Gad ki la khot ïa ka duwan ka Sakhi. Ki la ong, “Kan neh kum ka sakhi hapdeng jong ngi ba u Trai U dei u Blei.”
Slem slem hadien haba u Trai U la ai jingsuk ïa ki Israel na ki nongshun baroh sawdong, bad u Joshwa ruh u la tymmen ba la bun ki snem,
u la khot ïa ki paid Israel baroh, ïa ki nongïalam bad ki rangbah jong ki, ïa ki nongbishar bad ki rangbah treikam jong ki bad u la ong ha ki, “Nga la tymmen mynta bad nga la bun ki snem.
Phi la ïohi ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba u Trai u Blei jong phi U la leh ïa kine ki jait bynriew na ka bynta jong phi, namar dei u Trai u Blei jong phi Uba la ïaleh na ka bynta jong phi.

Hakhmih, nga la ai bynta ha phi kum ka nongkynti na ka bynta ki jait jong phi kito ki jait bynriew ba ym pat jop, lem bad kito ki jait bynriew kiba nga la pynduh khoit naduh ka Jordan haduh ka Duriaw Bakhraw sha sepngi.
U Trai u Blei jong phi Un sa khynñiat dadien ïa ki hakhmat jong phi, bad Un sa beh krad ïa ki nakhmat jong phi. Phin sa ïoh buhai ïa ka ri jong ki, kumba u Trai u Blei jong phi U la kular ïa phi.
Namarkata, to ïaineh ban rakhe bad ban leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba la thoh ha ka kitab jong ka aiñ u Moses, khlem da phai na ka sha kamon ne sha kadiang.
Wat ju ïakhleh lang bad kito ki jait bynriew kiba dang sah bad phi, ne wat ju nam ïa ki blei jong ki, ne wat ju smai da ki, ne wat shakri ïa ki, wat ju nguh ju dem hakhmat jong ki.
Hynrei to snoh ha u Trai u Blei jong phi, kumba phi la leh haduh mynta.
Naba u Trai U la beh krad nakhmat jong phi ïa ki jait bynriew ki bakhraw bad ki bakhlaiñ, bad ym pat don uwei u briew uba la lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa phi haduh mynta.
Tang uwei na phi u pynher ïap da ki hajar, namar dei u Trai u Blei jong phi Uba ïaleh na ka bynta jong phi, kumba U la kular ïa phi.
To da phikir bha ïa lade, namarkata, ban ieid ïa u Trai u Blei jong phi.

Hynrei lada phi tamsneng bad phi ïateh lok bad kito ki jait bynriew kiba dang sah bad phi, bad phi ïa shongkha shongman bad ki, ha kata ka rukom ba phi leit poikha ïa ki kynthei jong ki, ma ki pat ïa ki jong phi,

to tip skhem ba u Trai Un ym ïarap beh shuh ïa kito ki jait bynriew nakhmat jong phi. Kine kin sa long ki syrwiah bad ki jynriam ïa phi, ki dieng sympat ïa ki krung jong phi, bad ki shiah ïa ki khmat jong phi, haduh ba phin da ïap-duh ïap-dam na kane ka ri babha ba u Trai u Blei jong phi U la ai ïa phi.

“Te mynta nga la jan ki sngi ban leit kumba long lem ka pyrthei. Phi tip ha ki dohnud bad ki mynsiem jong phi, phi baroh, ba ym shym la bijai-ei wat kawei na kiei kiei ba u Trai u Blei jong phi U la kular shaphang jong phi. Baroh ki la urlong, ym shym don wat kawei kaba la pulom.

Hynrei kumba ïa kiei kiei ki babha la pyndep kumba la kular da u Trai u Blei jong phi, kumta ruh u Trai Un sa phah da ki jingjynjar suda haduh ba phin sa duh jait na kane ka ri babha ba u Trai u Blei jong phi U la ai ïa phi,

lada phi pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang u Trai u Blei jong phi, kaba U la hukum ïa phi bad phi leit shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei, da kaba nguh ba dem ruh ïa ki. Nangta u Trai Un sa meh ding lep da ka jingbitar ïa phi, bad phin sa jah lngaid kloi kloi na ka ri babha kaba U la ai ha phi.”

Te u Joshwa u la khot lang ïa ki jait Israel baroh ha Shekhem, bad u la phah wan ïa ki tymmen ki san, ki rangbah duh, ki nongbishar bad ki rangbah pynïaid kam ka Israel. Baroh ki la wan paw hakhmat u Blei.

Hangta u Joshwa u la kren ha u paidbah baroh, “U Trai u Blei ka Israel U ong kumne, ‘Ki kpa tymmen jong phi hyndai eh ki la shong sha lyndet ka wah Ïuphratis, kum u Tera, u kpa jong u Abraham bad u Nahor bad ki la shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei.
Te Nga la wanlam ïa u kpa jong phi u Abraham na sha shiliang kata ka wah, bad Nga la ïalam ïa u lyngba ka ri Kanaan baroh kawei. Nga la pynroi ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u, bad Nga la ai ïa u u Isaak.
Ha u Isaak Nga la ai u Jakob bad u Esaw. Ha u Esaw Nga la ai nongkynti ïa ka ri lum Seir, hynrei u Jakob bad ki khun jong u ki la leit sha Ijipt.
Te Nga la phah ïa u Moses bad u Aron, bad Nga la pynsasti haban da suwan khait ïa ka Ijipt da kiei kiei ba Nga leh ha ka. Nangta Nga la pynmih ïa phi.
Nga la pynmih ïa ki kpa jong phi na Ijipt bad phi la poi haduh duriaw. Shata ki nong Ijipt ki la beh nadien ïa ki kpa jong phi da ki kali bad ki nongshongkulai haduh ka Duriaw Basaw.

Hangta ki la kyang jam ha u Trai bad U la phah da ka jingdum hapdeng jong phi bad ki nong Ijipt, nangta U la pynwan ïa ka duriaw halor jong ki ban tyllep ïa ki. Kumta ki khmat jong phi ki la ïohi aïu Nga la leh ïa ka Ijipt, bad phi la shong slem slem ha ri kynjah.

Nangta Nga la wanlam ïa phi sha ka ri ki Amor kiba shong sha shiliang ka Jordan. Ki la ïaleh ïa phi, hynrei Nga la aiti ïa ki ha ka kti jong phi. Phi la buhai ïa ka ri jong ki, bad Nga la pynjot ïa ki hakhmat jong phi.
Nangta u Balak, u khun u Zippor, u syiem Moab, u la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Israel. U la phah khot ïa u Balaam, u khun u Beor ban tim ïa phi.
Hynrei Ngam shym shah shkor ïa u Balaam; namarkata u la kyrkhu pynban ïa phi. Kumta Nga la pyllait ïa phi na ka kti jong u.

Nangta phi la jam ïa ka Jordan bad phi la wan poi sha Jerikho. Ki nong Jerikho ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi, nangta sa ki Amor, ki Peris, ki Kanaan, ki Hit, ki Girkash, ki Hib bad ki Jebus. Hynrei Nga la aiti ïa ki ha ki kti jong phi.
Nga la phah da ki kyieng ha shuwa jong phi bad ki la pynher ïap ïa ki syiem Amor ha shuwa jong phi. Ym shym dei da ka waitlam ne ka ryntieh jong phi.
Nga la ai ïa phi ka ri kaba phim shym la trei, ki shnong kiba phim shym la tei, ba phin shong hangta. Phi la ïoh bam na u soh jong ki brisoh waiñ bad ki brisoh olib kiba phim shym la thung.

“Te namarkata to tiengburom ïa u Trai, bad to shakri ïa U da ka jingsngur mynsiem bad ka jingkohnguh. To bret noh ïa ki blei kiba ki kpa jong phi ki la mane mynba ki la don sha shiliang ka wah bad ha ri Ijipt, bad to shakri tang ïa u Trai.

Te lada phim mon shuh ban shakri ïa u Trai, to jied noh mynta ka sngi hi ïano phin shakri, lada ïa ki blei ba ki kpa jong phi ki la shakri ha ki thaiñ kiba sha lyndet ka wah, ne ïa ki blei jong ki Amor kiba ha ka ri jong ki phi shong. Nga ïa lade te bad ka ïing ka sem jong nga ngin shakri tang ïa u Trai.”
Ki paidbah hangta ki la jubab, “Horkit hordang ngin ym ieh noh ïa u Trai ban shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei.

Naba dei u Trai u Blei jong ngi Uba la wanlam ïa ngi bad ïa ki kpa jong ngi na ri Ijipt, na ka ïing jinglong mraw, bad Uba la leh ki dak ki bakhraw katto katto hakhmat jong ngi, bad Uba la ïada ïa ngi baroh shi lynter lynti katba ngi leit, bad hapdeng ki paid briew baroh ba ngi la ïaid lyngba.
Dei u Trai Uba la beh krad nakhmat jong ngi ïa ki paid briew baroh, ïa ki Amor ruh kiba la shong ha kane ka ri. Namarkata ngi ruh ngin shakri ïa u Trai namar U dei u Blei jong ngi.”

Hynrei u Joshwa u la ong ha ki paidbah, “Tip lada phin lah ban shakri ïa u Trai; namarba U long u Blei u bakhuid. U long u Blei Uba dawa jingieid marwei, bad Un ym map ïa ki jingpynkheiñ hukum ne ki pop jong phi.
Phi tang shu ieh noh ïa u Trai ban shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei, hangta Un kynriah na phi; Un pynshitom ïa phi bad—wat lada shisien U la leh bha ïa phi—U pynduh khoit ïa phi.”
Ki paidbah pat ki la jubab ïa u Joshwa, “Ym lei lei, namar ngin shakri hi ïa u Trai!”
Hangta u Joshwa u la phai ktien sha ki paidbah, “Phi long sakhi pyrshah ïa lade hi ba phi la jied ban shakri ïa u Trai.” Kumta ki la jubab, “Ngi long sakhi!”
Te u la ong, “To bret noh, haba kumta, ïa ki blei nongwei kiba don hapdeng jong phi, bad theh ïa la ka dohnud ha u Trai, u Blei ka Israel.”
Kumta ki paidbah ki la ong ha u Joshwa, “Ïa u Trai u Blei jong ngi ngin shakri, bad ïa ka ktien jong U ngin kohnguh!”
Kumta u Joshwa u la pynlong ka Jutang bad ki paidbah ha kata ka sngi, u da thaw ruh ki aiñ bad ki riti niam na ka bynta jong ki ha Shekhem.
U Joshwa u la thoh ïa kine ki ktien ha ka kitab jong ka aiñ u Blei, u la shim uwei u maw u baheh, bad u la buh ïa u hangta hapoh u dieng bti ha ka ïing bakhuid jong u Trai.

Nangta u Joshwa u la ong ha u paid baroh. “To kynmaw ba une u maw un long u sakhi pyrshah ïa ngi. U la ïohsngew ïa ki ktien baroh jong u Trai kiba U la kren ha ngi. Un long namarkata u sakhi pyrshah ïa phi, ïoh phi leh thok ïa u Blei jong phi.”
Hadien kata u Joshwa u la phah noh ïa u paid, uwei pa uwei sha la ka jaka jaka.
Hadien kine kiei kiei, u Joshwa u khun u Nun, u shakri u Trai, u la ïap, ynda u la dap shispah shiphew snem ka ryta.
Te ki la tep ïa u ha ka ri kynti jong u ha Timnath-sera, kaba ha ri lum Ephraim, shatei jong u lum Gaash.

Ki paid Israel ki la shakri ïa u Trai katba dang im u Joshwa, bad baroh ki sngi jong ki tymmen ki san kiba dang im hadien u Joshwa bad kiba la tip ïa ki kam baroh kiba u Trai U la leh na ka bynta ki paid Israel.

Ïa ki shyieng jong u Joseph, ba ki paid Israel ki la wanlam na Ijipt, la tep ha Shekhem ha ka bynta jong ka khyndew ba u Jakob u la thied na ki khun u Hamor, u kpa u Shekhem, kumba shispah sbai. Ka la long ka nongkynti jong ki khun ki ksiew u Joseph.
U Eleasar u khun u Aron ruh u la ïap bad ki la tep ïa u ha Gibea, ka shnong u Phinehas u khun jong u, kaba u la ïoh ha ri lum Ephraim.
